# Supported AI Providers and Models in K8sGPT

K8sGPT supports a variety of AI/LLM providers (backends). Some providers have a fixed set of supported models, while others allow you to specify any model supported by the provider.

## Providers and Supported Models

### OpenAI

- Model: User-configurable (any model supported by OpenAI, e.g.,gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4, etc.)

### Azure OpenAI

- Model: User-configurable (any model deployed in your Azure OpenAI resource)
- Deployment: Use--engine to set the Azure deployment name when it differs from the model name.
- API version: Use--azureAPIVersion or K8SGPT_AZURE_API_VERSION to override the Azure OpenAI API version.

### LocalAI

- Model: User-configurable (default:llama3)

### Ollama

- Model: User-configurable (default:llama3, others can be specified)

### GPT2Giga (gpt2giga)

- Model: User-configurable
- API: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API
- Endpoint: Defaults tohttp://localhost:8090; override with --baseurl

### NoOpAI

- Model: N/A (no real model, used for testing)

### Cohere

- Model: User-configurable (any model supported by Cohere)

# A psychology PhD taught AI to hear when you're sad, stressed or happy; now Google DeepMind has hired him to bring that empathy to Gemini

Synopsis

Alan Cowen has a PhD in psychology. He is an American computational scientist and entrepreneur. Cowen specialises in human emotions and artificial intelligence (AI). He completed his PhD from the University of California, Berkeley. His focus has been the development of AI that can both think and speak. He also focused on its optimization for human well-being.

A psychology researcher used his understanding of human emotions to build AI that can recognise feelings through voice. Later, Google DeepMind hired him to bring that technology to Gemini. Earlier this year, under a new licensing agreement, Google DeepMind claimed that it is bringing on the CEO and several of the top engineers at voice AI startup Hume AI. It was said in the announcement that CEO Alan Cowen and around seven other engineers will work with DeepMind. Their aim would be to improve Gemini's voice features, according to Wired.

## Who is Alan Cowen?
Alan Cowen has a PhD in psychology. He is an American computational scientist and entrepreneur. Cowen specialises in human emotions and artificial intelligence (AI). He completed his PhD from the University of California, Berkeley.
His focus has been the development of AI that can both think and speak. He also focused on its optimization for human well-being.

Alan Cowen.

His past research introduced computational methods to address how emotional behaviours can be predicted, and emulated. He explored how human emotional expressions can be measured and understood using machine learning. His research examined the various ways people express their feelings.

ALSO READ: At 21, he had just $5,000 in savings and started reselling discarded corporate computers; here's how his business grew into a multimillion-dollar company

## All about Hume AI
Cowen had identified a big opportunity. It was to build AI systems that could recognise emotional signals in human communication. He later co-founded Hume AI and developed technology that would allow machines to learn emotional expressions and respond to them more naturally.
ALSO READ: He sold his company to Walmart for $310 million after investing just $60,000 to start it; what happened behind the scenes?

The main goal was to understand a user's emotions and mood based on their voice. The startup launched its Empathetic Voice Interface in 2024. It was a conversational AI with emotional intelligence. Hume AI had raised close to $80 million to date according to PitchBook.

## Why did Google DeepMind hire him?
Google DeepMind hired the CEO Alan Cowen and several top engineers from Hume AI as part of a new licensing agreement. The deal showed that voice is becoming the next frontier in AI. The technology of the startup would help improve how Gemini interprets users' emotions and adjusts its responses.

# Google DeepMind Unveils Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a 2.5x Faster Agentic AI Model

Google DeepMind has released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a closed-weights model built for agentic workflows and coding tasks. It runs 2.5x faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash and features a 1M token context window.

Hiren Dave
Founder

### KEY TAKEAWAYS

Context window

1,048,576 tokens, unified across input, thinking, and output

Input modalities

text, images, audio, video, PDFs, tables, charts

Synchronous output cap

65,536 tokens

Thinking levels

low, medium, high, xhigh (default is high)

## Google Releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a 2.5x Faster Model for Agentic Workflows

Google DeepMind has released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a closed-weights model designed specifically for agentic workflows and coding tasks. The model, identified asgemini-4-hydrogen, is positioned below the frontier-tier Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Argon in Google's lineup, and is described internally as the "daily driver for agentic workflows," according to the launch coverage.

The headline claim is speed: Hydrogen completes tasks 2.5x faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash at the default high thinking level. In partner testing, the model ran 2x to 2.8x faster while consuming 12% to 23% fewer tokens.

## Technical Specifications

- Context window: 1,048,576 tokens, unified across input, thinking, and output
- Input modalities: text, images, audio, video, PDFs, tables, charts
- Output: text only
- Synchronous output cap: 65,536 tokens
- Thinking levels: low, medium, high, xhigh (default is high)
- Knowledge cutoff: March 2026
- Serving: Google-hosted API only; no open weights, no quantized variants, no self-hosting
- Architecture and parameter count: not disclosed

## Performance Benchmarks

Google's self-reported benchmark results show significant gains over the previous generation:

On Agent Arena, Hydrogen ranks #5, and it costs 2x the introductory price of Gemini 3.8 Flash. The model also reports more than 5x fewer fabricated claims than 3.8 Flash, scoring 96.7% on an internal agent honesty evaluation and 2.3x more resilience to indirect prompt injection on Gray Swan's benchmark.

Benchmark | Gemini 4 Hydrogen | Gemini 3.8 Flash 
---|---|---
Terminal-Bench 4.1 | 57% | 18.2% 
Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (v5.0) | 51 (high), 54 (xhigh) | Not disclosed 
HLE-Diamond | 58.8% | — 
Vals Tax Agent Bench | 52.3% (#1) | — 
Agents' Last Exam v1.1 | 71.6% | — 

## Multi-Agent Role-Splitting

A key architectural feature is the role-splitting pattern in Google Antigravity. An Orchestrator switches models within a single task: Carbon handles exploration, ambiguity resolution, and planning, while Hydrogen executes file edits, package updates, and test runs. When Hydrogen encounters friction, control returns to Carbon. This pairing achieved near-Carbon task success rates on Terminal-Bench 4.1 while using 24% less quota and finishing 19% faster than Carbon alone.

## Pricing and Availability

The API price is $1.50 per 1M input tokens and $7.50 per 1M output tokens, flat across the full 1M context window. Output pricing includes thinking tokens. Implicit caching reduces input cost to $0.075 per 1M for prompts of 4,096 tokens or more. Explicit caching is not supported.

For context, Gemini 3.8 Flash is priced at $0.75/$3.75 until December 31, 2026, after which it rises to $1.50/$7.50, matching Hydrogen's rate. Gemini 4 Argon costs $2/$10 until November 30, 2026, then $4/$20.

Hydrogen is available in the Gemini API, Google AI Studio on all tiers, Android Studio, the Gemini app, Google Search, and Sheets. Antigravity access requires Google AI Pro or Ultra. Developers migrating from 3.8 Flash must removetemperature, top_p, and top_k parameters (the server ignores them), remove cached_content fields, and raise any hardcoded max_output_tokens caps to 65,536.

## Google DeepMind Ships Gemini 4 Neon

Google DeepMind has released Gemini 4 Neon, a new model positioned between Hydrogen and Carbon in the Gemini lineup. The model delivers reasoning quality approaching that of Carbon while offering a 1M token context window, targeting use cases that demand high throughput and lower inference costs without a significant drop in output quality.

## Technical Specifications

Gemini 4 Neon introduces several architectural and operational distinctions:

- Context window: 1M tokens, enabling processing of substantially longer documents, codebases, or multimodal inputs in a single pass
- Multimodal input support: text, images, video, audio, and PDFs
- Thinking levels: four distinct levels that allow developers to trade off between reasoning depth, latency, and cost per request
- Positioning: sits between Hydrogen (lighter, faster) and Carbon (heavier, higher quality) in the Gemini 4 family

## Why It Matters

The 1M token context window is the most significant differentiator. For developers working with large codebases, lengthy legal documents, or extended video content, this eliminates the need for chunking strategies or retrieval-augmented generation pipelines that add latency and complexity. The multimodal support across five input types in a single model also reduces the need to route requests through multiple specialized endpoints.

The tiered thinking levels address a common production concern: not every inference call requires maximum reasoning. By exposing this as a configurable parameter rather than requiring separate model selection, DeepMind simplifies cost management at scale.

## Implications for Production Workloads

For teams already using the Gemini 4 family, Neon offers a middle ground that may reduce inference spend on workloads previously handled by Carbon where the quality delta is acceptable. The combination of a 1M context window and multimodal input in a single model also reduces architectural overhead in pipelines that previously required separate document parsing, image processing, and summarization stages.

# Genie 4 Is Now Available on the Gemini API and Google AI Studio

Google has made Genie 4 available to developers through the Gemini API, via the Interactions API, and in Google AI Studio. Google’s announcement presents this as following the Genie 4 launch the day before.

## What did Google announce?

Developers can start from a text prompt, a reference image, or both, and experiment with generating continuous worlds. Google specifies the output as follows:

- Video: 720p at 24fps, continuous.
- Audio: synchronized native audio, from ambient soundscapes and sound effects to character dialogue.
- Provenance: every output includes imperceptible SynthID watermarking.

The announcement also describes live control. You navigate the environment with real-time keyboard controls and use live text prompts to change weather, lighting, objects, or events on the fly. Google says Gemini reasoning keeps the world state consistent and coherent throughout.

## Why does it matter?

Google positions Genie 4 as a blank canvas for testing ideas. It names three uses:

- Prototyping interactive experiences.
- Visualizing designs for spatial concepts.
- Training robotics and AI agents.

These are Google’s framing of possible uses, not results the announcement documents. The post gives no benchmarks, example projects, or measurements for any of them.

What is concrete is the access route: the Gemini API via the Interactions API, and Google AI Studio, where Google highlights an interactive canvas and starter apps.

## How does this differ from earlier reporting?

Earlier coverage described a different status. An Apidog article dated October 29, 2026 said Genie 4 had no public API at that point. It described Genie 4 as a research preview for trusted testers that Google DeepMind said was “coming soon” to early access partners of the Gemini API and Google AI Studio. It also said no date, documentation, model ID, or price had been published.

Google’s newer post says Genie 4 is available through the Gemini API and AI Studio and points to pricing details and documentation. Treat the Apidog piece as a snapshot of the earlier status, not a description of current availability.

The Google post does not say whether access is limited to a particular group of developers. It also does not name a model ID, rate limits, or session length.

Apidog also quotes Google DeepMind’s caveat about the research preview: environments stay coherent “over short sessions,” while details and object permanence “can still shift or drift over time.” That quote comes from the earlier announcement as reported by Apidog, not from the newer post.

## What does this mean for developers?

The supplied sources support only a short list of statements:

- Genie 4 is available through the Gemini API, via the Interactions API.
- Google AI Studio offers an interactive canvas and starter apps.
- Prompts can be text, an image, or both, and the world can be steered live with keyboard input and text prompts.
- Outputs carry SynthID watermarking, which is relevant if you plan to show or distribute generated material.

The sources do not provide request formats, code samples, model identifiers, or pricing figures, so this article does not guess at them.

## What should you do next?

Google’s announcement points to these steps:

- Try the interactive canvas and starter apps in Google AI Studio.
- Review pricing details.
- Explore the Gemini API documentation to begin building.

As an additional recommendation, not something the announcement says: after your first generation in AI Studio, run a longer session and note whether details or objects drift. That tests the limitation Google DeepMind flagged earlier, as reported by Apidog, against your own use case.

# Meta Model API

The Meta Model API (public preview) serves Meta Superintelligence Labs' Muse Spark models through an OpenAI-compatible API. The Meta provider extends the OpenAI provider and supports its compatible options.

note

This provider uses the Meta Model API atapi.meta.ai for Muse models. Meta retired the separate Llama API at api.llama.com on July 6, 2026.

## Setup

- Create an API key from the API keys tab on the Meta Model API dashboard.
- Set theMODEL_API_KEY environment variable, or specify apiKey or a custom apiKeyEnvar in your config.

providers:
  - id: meta:muse-spark-1.3

meta:<model> defaults to the Responses API — Meta's full-feature surface and the one its docs recommend. Use meta:chat:<model> for the OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint, or meta:messages:<model> for the Anthropic-compatible Messages API. If you omit the model, the provider defaults to muse-spark-1.1; select muse-spark-1.3 explicitly to use the latest model.

## Available Models

Check the models page for the live list. As of writing:

- muse-spark-1.3 — latest model for coding and agentic workflows, with a 1,048,576-token context window, text/image/video/PDF input, tool calling, structured output, and search grounding.
- muse-spark-1.3-contributor — the same model with discounted pricing. Selecting this ID permits Meta to use your prompts and completions to train future models.
- muse-spark-1.1 — original Muse Spark model, still supported.

Both 1.3 IDs work with the Responses, Chat Completions, and Messages APIs. Meta notes that audio understanding in 1.3 is not fully supported and may produce degraded responses.

## Configuration
providers:
  - id: meta:muse-spark-1.3
    config:
      reasoning_effort: high
      max_completion_tokens: 8192
      temperature: 1.0

### Configuration Options

The provider accepts compatible OpenAI provider options. Notable behavior:

- reasoning_effort — minimal, low, medium, high, or xhigh. When omitted, the model picks its own reasoning depth. Muse Spark does not support none; the provider rejects it with a clear error. Reasoning tokens bill at the output rate and count toward the output cap.
- max_completion_tokens — caps generation on the chat endpoint (Meta accepts max_tokens only as a deprecated alias; if you set it, the provider forwards it as the canonical max_completion_tokens). On the Responses API the cap is max_output_tokens, and the provider maps max_completion_tokens/max_tokens onto it. When unset, no cap is sent so reasoning can use the full output budget.
- temperature — supported (0–2, API default 1.0). Promptfoo sends its deterministic default of 0 unless you override it.
- response_format — structured output with guaranteed JSON schema matching.
- tools / tool_choice — parallel tool calling with streamed arguments.
- prompt_cache_retention — in_memory or 24h for prompt caching; cached prompt tokens bill at the cached-input rate.
- seed — best-effort determinism.

On Chat Completions and Responses, promptfoo rejectslogprobs, n > 1, stop, and logit_bias before sending a request. It also rejects stream because these integrations expect a complete JSON response. OpenAI-scoped environment defaults (OPENAI_TEMPERATURE, OPENAI_TOP_P, OPENAI_MAX_COMPLETION_TOKENS, penalty variables) are not applied to Meta requests.

### Cost Tracking

Promptfoo computes token cost from Meta's published pricing, including the discounted rate for cached input:

Model | Input / 1M | Cached input / 1M | Output / 1M 
---|---|---|---
muse-spark-1.3, muse-spark-1.1 | $1.25 | $0.15 | $4.25 
muse-spark-1.3-contributor | $0.10 | $0.002 | $0.20 

Contributor pricing requires opting into Meta's training data terms by selecting the Contributor model ID. Override token prices withcost, inputCost, outputCost, or cacheReadCost (USD per token) for custom rates. Token cost excludes web-search charges.

## Responses API

meta:<model> (the default) and meta:responses:<model> target Meta's /v1/responses endpoint — the only Meta endpoint that carries reasoning across turns, with built-in web-search grounding:
providers:
  - id: meta:responses:muse-spark-1.3
    config:
      reasoning_effort: medium
      tools:
        - type: web_search

Withweb_search, the model grounds answers in real-time web results with inline citations. Web search bills separately ($2.50 per 1,000 queries) and is not included in promptfoo's computed token cost.

## Messages API

meta:messages:<model> targets Meta's Anthropic-compatible Messages endpoint (https://api.meta.ai/v1/messages) — the surface Anthropic-format coding agents such as Claude Code use. Use it to evaluate Muse Spark over the same wire format those agents send:
providers:
  - id: meta:messages:muse-spark-1.3
    config:
      max_tokens: 8192

The provider extends the Anthropic provider, so its options (max_tokens, tools, image and document content blocks, etc.) apply. It defaults max_tokens to 131,072 and enables streaming so the Anthropic SDK can safely handle long generations; streamed output is aggregated before grading. Authentication uses your Meta key as a bearer token (Authorization: Bearer), matching Meta's docs — Anthropic-scoped settings like ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_MAX_TOKENS, ANTHROPIC_TEMPERATURE, custom headers, and Claude Code OAuth credentials are deliberately ignored on this surface.

Muse Spark's reasoning arrives on this surface as encryptedredacted_thinking blocks, so the provider defaults showThinking to false to keep the ciphertext out of graded output.

## Using with coding-agent providers

Meta positions Muse Spark as a backend for coding agents, and promptfoo's agentic providers can evaluate those setups end to end. In both recipes, setapiKey explicitly: the agent subprocesses inherit your shell environment, and an explicit key guarantees your Meta key is used instead of an ambient OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY that belongs to another service.

### Codex CLI

Theopenai:codex-sdk provider drives Muse Spark over the Responses API:
providers:
  - id: openai:codex-sdk
    config:
      base_url: https://api.meta.ai/v1
      model: muse-spark-1.3
      apiKey: '{{env.MODEL_API_KEY}}'

The explicitapiKey is required — the provider does not read MODEL_API_KEY on its own, and without it an ambient OPENAI_API_KEY would be sent to the Meta endpoint instead.

### Claude Code

Theanthropic:claude-agent-sdk provider forwards config.env to the agent subprocess. Pass the environment Meta's guide prescribes, with apiKey set to your Meta key:
providers:
  - id: anthropic:claude-agent-sdk
    # Provider-level `env` outranks the eval's top-level `env`, pinning the
    # routing values a suite-wide ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (e.g. an Anthropic
    # gateway) would otherwise override — which would send the Meta key there.
    env:
      ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: https://api.meta.ai
      ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS: ''
    config:
      apiKey: '{{env.MODEL_API_KEY}}'
      env:
        ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: https://api.meta.ai
        ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN: '{{env.MODEL_API_KEY}}'
        ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS: ''
        ANTHROPIC_MODEL: muse-spark-1.3
        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL: muse-spark-1.3
        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL: muse-spark-1.3
        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL: muse-spark-1.3
        CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL: muse-spark-1.3
        ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH: 'true' # Claude Code disables MCP tool search for non-first-party hosts

warning

Do not omitapiKey, the empty ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS override, or the provider-level env block. The provider forwards its resolved API key into the agent subprocess as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY after env: is applied — if apiKey is unset and a real ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is exported in your shell, that Anthropic credential would be transmitted to Meta's endpoint. Clearing ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS prevents an inherited gateway or proxy secret from being sent to Meta. The provider-level env block matters because the subprocess environment is layered process.env < config.env < provider/suite env: without the pin, a top-level env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL in the same config would silently re-route the agent — and your Meta key — to that URL.

Pin every model alias as shown — Claude Code otherwise routes background tasks, Plan Mode, or subagents to Claude models the Meta API doesn't serve. See Meta's coding agents guide for the full setup pattern.

## Example Usage
providers:
  - id: meta:muse-spark-1.3
  - id: openai:gpt-5.5

prompts:
  - 'Summarize the following in one sentence: {{text}}'

tests:
  - vars:
      text: 'Promptfoo is an open-source tool for testing and evaluating LLM apps.'

Get started with a runnable example:
npx promptfoo@latest init --example provider-meta

- Base URL:https://api.meta.ai/v1 (override with apiBaseUrl; the Messages surface uses the bare host https://api.meta.ai).

- Rate limits apply per team, not per key: 3,000 RPM / 4M TPM for Standard models and 100 RPM / 3M TPM for Contributor models.
- Full API documentation.

# Llama 5: Is There Even a Llama 5? Release Date Rumors, Checked

There is no Llama 5. Meta has never announced or released a model by that name, and its last Llama release was Llama 4, on 5 April 2025. Meta’s 2026 models ship under a new name, Muse, and its newest open-weight model is Muse Spark Open, released on 15 October 2026.

Search for Llama 5 and you will still find pages saying it launched in April, or in June, with 600 billion parameters and a multi-million-token context window. This guide checks each of those claims against Meta’s own pages and its Hugging Face account. It also explains how the Llama line turned into Muse, and how likely a model with that name is to ship at all.

## The Key Takeaways
- Not released: Meta’s meta-llama Hugging Face account has no Llama 5. Its newest model was uploaded in April 2025.
- The fake launches: pages claim Llama 5 shipped on 8 April, around 15 April and 17 June 2026. One has been retracted, and none cites a Meta source.
- What happened instead: the next Meta flagship, codenamed Avocado, shipped as the closed Muse Spark on 8 April 2026.
- The open successor: Muse Spark Open (816B parameters, 42B active) arrived on 15 October 2026 and runs on two M5 Ultra Mac Studios.
- The odds: Manifold traders give a model named Llama 5 about a 1% chance before 2027.

## Is Llama 5 Out?

No. Llama 5 has not been released, previewed or named by Meta. A search of Meta’s meta-llama account on Hugging Face, where every Llama model has been published, returns no Llama 5 repository. The newest uploads there are Llama Guard 4 and Prompt Guard 2, from late April 2025.

Meta’s own writing treats Llama 4 as the end of the line. Meta’s April 2026 launch post for Muse Spark compares the new training stack with the old one. Meta says it reaches the same capability “with over an order of magnitude less compute than our previous model, Llama 4 Maverick.”

The previous model is a Llama 4, not a Llama 5.

The table shows where each Meta model family stands as of 9 November 2026.

Model | Released | Weights 
---|---|---
Llama 4 Scout and Maverick | 5 April 2025 | Open (Llama 4 license) 
Llama 4 Behemoth | Announced, never released | None 
Muse Spark (1.0 to 1.3) | 8 April 2026, updated to 2 September | Closed 
Muse Glimmer 30B | 10 August 2026 | Open (Apache 2.0) 
Muse Wonder | 12 October 2026 | Closed 
Muse Spark Open | 15 October 2026 | Open (Muse Model License) 
Llama 5 | Not announced | None 

## Why Search Results Say Llama 5 Already Shipped

Search results say Llama 5 shipped because several AI blogs published launch stories for a model that does not exist. The stories disagree with each other on the date, the size and the lineup, and none of them links to a Meta announcement, a model card or a download.

### The 8 April Story That Was Retracted

RAGyfied, an AI learning site, published a page on 11 April 2026 saying Llama 5 had been released three days earlier. The page gave it 600 billion parameters and a 5 million token context window. RAGyfied has since corrected it. The correction says the earlier version “relied on an unverified secondary report, and no Meta source supports it.” The date was not random: 8 April 2026 is the day Meta launched Muse Spark, a different model under a different name.

### The “April 15” Brief That Cites a Physics Paper

Tech Jacks Solutions published a brief saying Meta released Llama 5 on “approximately April 15, 2026” as a 600B+ parameter open-weights model that can refine its own weights. The brief gives arXiv 2604.11002 as the technical report. That arXiv number belongs to a physics paper on leptogenesis, not to Meta. The link the brief labels as its Meta AI Blog source points to an unrelated hardware reseller’s blog post about Claude.

### The 17 June Three-Model Launch

TokenCalculator, a token-counting tool site, still runs a review that opens: “Meta released three Llama 5 models on June 17: Scout, Maverick and Behemoth.” The review adds prices per million tokens and a revised Llama 5 Community License. Those are the Llama 4 model names. No Meta page and no Hugging Face repository shows a Llama 5 Scout, Maverick or Behemoth.

### “Meta Has Confirmed” With No Meta Source

AI Omni Feed’s release watch was last updated on 7 September 2026. It opens with “Meta has confirmed that Llama 5’s training run is ahead of schedule.” The page links to no Meta statement, and we found no such statement on Meta’s blogs. The page also lists a 1 trillion parameter design, a 256K context window and benchmark scores, all described as internal and none published by Meta.

## Llama 5 Rumors, Graded

Every Llama 5 claim in circulation fails the same test: none points to a Meta announcement, a model card or downloadable weights. The table grades the main claims against what Meta has actually published.

Claim | Who says it | What we checked | Verdict 
---|---|---|---
Llama 5 released 8 April 2026, 600B, 5M context | RAGyfied (April 2026) | RAGyfied’s own correction | Retracted 
Llama 5 released around 15 April 2026, 600B+, self-improving | Tech Jacks Solutions | Cited arXiv ID is a physics paper | False 
Llama 5 Scout, Maverick and Behemoth released 17 June | TokenCalculator | No Hugging Face repo, no Meta post | False 
Meta confirmed Llama 5 training finishes August 2026 | AI Omni Feed | No Meta statement exists | Unsupported 
Meta’s next model, Avocado, will be closed | Bloomberg (December 2025) | Muse Spark launched closed in April | Confirmed 
Llama 5 was cancelled | A release tracker on X (October 2025) | No Llama 5 since; Meta moved to Muse | Likely, never official 

The cancellation claim is the only one the record supports, and even that was a reading of events rather than an announcement. Kol Tregaskes, who tracks AI releases on X, put it this way in October 2025, six months before Muse Spark launched.

I don't think it's news to say Llama 5 is cancelled.  The new Meta lab are to build a new model and I would say the "Llama" name has been stained from the Llama 4 mess.
— Kol Tregaskes (@koltregaskes) October 13, 2025

## What Happened to Llama 5: From Avocado to Muse

The model people expected to be Llama 5 became Muse Spark, a closed model, and Meta moved its open-weight work under the Muse name. The change happened in four steps over ten months.

### December 2025: Avocado Is Reported as Closed

Bloomberg reported in December 2025 that Meta was shifting its focus to a new model codenamed Avocado. Avocado was expected to launch as a closed model, so that Meta could sell access directly. According to The Decoder’s summary of that report, the open approach had lost support inside Meta after Llama 4’s disappointing reception. The work sat with Alexandr Wang’s new Meta Superintelligence Labs.

### April 2026: Avocado Ships as Muse Spark

Meta launched Muse Spark on 8 April 2026 as the first model from Meta Superintelligence Labs, and The Next Web reported that it was the model known internally as Avocado. Muse Spark is closed. It powers the Meta AI app and meta.ai, and Meta opened only a private API preview at launch. Our guide to Meta Muse Spark covers the launch benchmarks, and the Muse Spark 1.3 review covers the September update.

### August 2026: The First Open Muse Model

Meta released Muse Glimmer on 10 August 2026. It is a 30 billion parameter model under the Apache 2.0 license, distilled from Muse Spark and, according to Hugging Face, ideal for running locally. On the same day, CNBC reported, Mark Zuckerberg said Meta would also open the weights of Muse Spark 1.2.

### October 2026: Muse Spark Open

Meta released Muse Spark Open on 15 October 2026, three days after launching its closed flagship, Muse Wonder. Meta’s official AI account announced the open model with its key specs.

Today we’re releasing Muse Spark Open, the most capable US open-weight model to date.
— AI at Meta (@AIatMeta) October 15, 2026
Built for coding and agentic work, it excels at long-horizon tasks, complex software engineering, and multi-step reasoning.
Key Model Specs:
→ 816B total / 42B active parameters
→ 1M token context window
→ Natively multimodal across text, image, video, audio

## Is Muse Spark Open the Real Llama 5?

Muse Spark Open is the closest thing to the Llama 5 people were waiting for: a large open-weight Meta model that anyone can download. It is not called Llama, and it differs from the Llama line in three ways that matter if you planned to build on it.

First, the size. Muse Spark Open is a mixture-of-experts model with 816 billion parameters, of which about 42 billion run for each token, and a 1 million token context window. It reads text, images, video and audio, and it answers in text. Hugging Face’s launch post puts the BF16 checkpoint at about 1.5 TB.

Second, the hardware. Meta says the model was optimized for Apple’s Mac Studio with the M5 Ultra chip, using Apple’s MLX framework. Meta’s announcement says each Mac Studio lets its GPU use up to 512 GB of memory. That means “two machines can hold an entire model.” Engadget estimated that the alternative setup, four Mac Studios with 256 GB each, costs roughly $38,000. The machines are covered in our M5 Ultra Mac Studio guide.

Meta.title: Meta Llama、Gemini、Qwen 在騷擾研究中揭示防護機制漏洞 | Gate 新聞
Meta.description: Georgia State、Georgia Tech 和 UC Berkeley 的研究人員發現，Google Gemini、Meta Llama、Alibaba Qwen 和 DeepSeek 在多輪騷擾攻擊下暴露出嚴重的安全防護漏洞 ... Google 的 Gemini、Meta 的 Llama、Alibaba 的 Qwen...
Meta.content:
Meta Llama、Gemini、Qwen 在騷擾研究中揭示防護機制漏洞

關鍵要點

Georgia State、Georgia Tech 和 UC Berkeley 的研究人員發現，Google Gemini、Meta Llama、Alibaba Qwen 和 DeepSeek 在多輪騷擾攻擊下暴露出嚴重的安全防護漏洞。

在約 200 段騷擾對話上進行微調後，模型生成騷擾內容的比例升至 97%，顯示極少的訓練資料就能突破安全防護。

敵意行為會在 AI Agent 接連互動的過程中累積並加劇，而非維持不變，為部署 AI Agent 執行面向客戶工作的組織帶來日益升高的營運風險。

一項獲人工智慧促進協會網路與社群媒體會議接受的研究顯示，用來防止模型產生有害行為的 AI 防護措施，遠比原先認為的脆弱。喬治亞州立大學 Robinson 商學院、喬治亞理工學院及加州大學柏克萊分校的研究人員，測試了以四種廣泛使用的模型系列為基礎打造的 AI Agent：Google 的 Gemini、Meta 的 Llama、Alibaba 的 Qwen，以及 DeepSeek。研究結果顯示，透過多輪對話反覆互動，能有系統地突破安全防線，導致模型大規模持續產生騷擾內容。

這項研究題為「Echoes of Human Malice in Agents: Benchmarking LLMs for Multi-Turn Online Harassment Attacks」，作者為 Trilok Padhi 等人，目前已刊載於 arXiv 預印本伺服器，DOI 為 10.48550/arxiv.2510.14207。喬治亞州立大學 Robinson 商學院助理教授、該研究共同作者及共同主持人 Ugur Kursuncu 表示：「不法行為者可能不需要龐大資源，就能誘使這些 Agent 產生有害行為。」這項研究將焦點從單次請求的拒答測試，轉向模仿現實世界網路傷害逐步累積的多輪騷擾情境。

多輪騷擾測試方法

大多數 AI 安全測試會評估模型是否會拒絕單一、孤立的有害請求。研究團隊注意到，網路騷擾是透過反覆互動逐步發展的，起初可能無傷大雅，之後才逐漸升級。為了模擬這種模式，研究人員打造了一個模擬聊天情境，讓一個 AI Agent 扮演騷擾者，另一個扮演其目標，最多進行 10 輪對話。對話以 Twitter 和 Instagram 上真實的騷擾貼文作為素材。

研究團隊嘗試透過三種不同方法突破騷擾者 Agent 的防護措施：將有毒的先前對話輸入 Agent 的記憶、提示它規劃騷擾策略，以及使用騷擾對話微調或重新訓練 Agent。Kursuncu 強調，這些攻擊不仰賴明顯的侮辱性詞語或露骨言詞。他解釋：「一開始可能非常隱晦，只是評論對方，接著就變成貶低、羞辱的言論。不一定要使用有毒的語言，可能從隱晦的內容開始，最後演變成非常露骨的攻擊。」

各模型系列的防護脆弱性

研究人員記錄了所有三種攻擊方法對受測模型防護措施造成的重大弱點。以騷擾對話重新訓練後，有一個模型在約 96% 的對話中進行騷擾，只有約 1% 的情況會拒絕。即使只使用 10% 的資料進行重新訓練（約 200 段對話），騷擾率仍升至約 97%，顯示模型不需要大量有害訓練資料，就可能轉而產生辱罵行為。

知名模型也顯現出相近的弱點。在基準騷擾者 Agent 測試條件下，Gemini 在 39% 的對話中產生騷擾內容。若在模型的上下文中加入有毒記憶，攻擊成功率便升至 99% 以上。即使在沒有任何攻擊操弄的基準條件下，Qwen 也顯示出極易受影響，在 92% 以上的對話中產生騷擾內容，且未經任何攻擊操弄。

研究人員觀察到，日常的刻薄言行比明確有害的內容更常繞過防護措施。模型輸出中，侮辱和敵意爆發遠比性騷擾或種族騷擾常見，顯示防護措施在抑制露骨的性或種族相關內容方面，比抑制日常攻擊和貶低言論更有效。

互動過程中敵意累積

多輪互動中出現一項關鍵發現：有害行為並非維持不變，而是在後續互動中逐漸加劇。Kursuncu 表示：「情況並沒有維持原樣，而是隨時間不斷加劇。這些不良行為會在互動中累積並擴散，即使企業設置的防護措施仍然存在。」這種升級是因為 AI Agent 能記住先前的互動、依據先前回應調整措辭，並逐步加強攻擊——這些能力仿效人類騷擾者的行為，卻以機器的速度和規模執行。

訓練資料中的潛在模式

研究標題「Revealing Echoes of Human Malice」點出一個根本的架構問題：AI 模型是在大量人類創作內容上預訓練，而這些內容本身就包含網路上既有的有害行為。這些訓練資料集規模過於龐大，無法在初始預訓練期間全面篩查。之後，企業會在專門階段加入安全訓練，以抑制有害輸出。然而，後續階段的安全訓練無法預先涵蓋底層模型中的有害模式可能遭觸發或利用的所有途徑。

Kursuncu 解釋：「這些模型學習的網路環境中早已存在人類的惡意行為，我們只是試圖揭露這些行為。安全訓練確實存在，但無法涵蓋這些模型可能造成的所有不同類型傷害。」這形成一段脆弱窗口：懷有惡意的人可以提供特定指示、提示或訓練資料，有策略地引出嵌入底層模型架構中的有毒行為。

商業風險與營運風險

隨著企業將 AI Agent 部署於客服、銷售、人力資源和分析等職務，企業領導者面臨日益升高的營運與聲譽風險。Kursuncu 指出，組織面臨的關鍵問題已經改變：「問題不再只是模型是否準確，而是 Agent 隨時間運作時，是否能遵守組織的規則與價值觀。」偏離預期行為或組織準則的 Agent，可能引發法律責任、聲譽受損、財務損失及客戶信任流失；在金融和醫療等受監管產業中，這些風險尤其值得關注。

這項研究凸顯了學術界對 AI 安全的疑慮與更迫切實際威脅之間的差異：前者關注 AI 系統是否可能產生意識或形成獨立的惡意意圖；後者則是惡意行為者自動化有害行為，其規模是任何單一人類都無法達到的。Kursuncu 表示：「以前，我們擔心個別人類可能如何傷害社會。現在，我們得開始擔心一支 Agent 大軍可能以大得多的規模造成這種傷害。」

網路騷擾在人類社群中早已十分普遍。根據 Pew Research，約 41% 的美國成年人表示曾遭遇網路騷擾，女性、少數族裔及其他弱勢群體受到的影響尤其嚴重。透過 AI Agent 自動化此類騷擾的能力，會進一步擴大其普遍程度和影響範圍。

常見問題

研究人員如何測試 AI 模型是否容易受到騷擾攻擊？

研究人員建構了由兩個 Agent 參與的模擬對話，讓一個 AI Agent 扮演騷擾者，另一個扮演其目標，最多進行 10 輪。對話以 Twitter 和 Instagram 上真實的騷擾貼文作為素材。研究團隊透過三種方法嘗試突破防護措施：將有毒的先前對話輸入 Agent 的記憶、提示 Agent 規劃騷擾策略，以及使用騷擾對話資料集微調 Agent。這種多輪方法與標準的單次請求安全測試不同，它模擬了現實世界中的騷擾如何透過反覆互動逐步發展並升級。

哪些 AI 模型在基準條件下最容易產生騷擾內容？

在測試的四種模型系列中，Qwen 在沒有任何攻擊操弄的情況下，基準脆弱性最高，在 92% 以上的對話中產生騷擾內容。Gemini 的基準騷擾率為 39%，呈現中度脆弱性；加入有毒記憶作為上下文後，騷擾率大幅升至 99% 以上。研究發現，Google Gemini、Meta Llama、Alibaba Qwen 和 DeepSeek 這四種模型系列，在不同攻擊方法下都顯現出重大防護弱點。

這項研究對部署於商業環境中的 AI Agent 有何影響？

隨著 AI Agent 越來越多地部署於客服、銷售、人力資源和分析等職務，並具備更多記憶、工具存取權限及自主性，組織面臨的風險也日益升高。Kursuncu 指出，企業領導者面臨的關鍵問題，已從「模型是否準確？」轉變為「Agent 隨時間運作時，是否能遵守組織的規則與價值觀？」偏離預期行為的 Agent，可能引發法律責任、聲譽受損、財務損失及客戶信任流失；在金融和醫療等受監管產業中，這些風險尤其值得關注。研究顯示，必須採取更完善的防護措施、監控和控管，才能防止惡意行為者大規模挪用 AI 系統來達成有害目的。

涨跌幅与 K 线开盘时间

24 小时制

Meta Llama、Gemini 和 Qwen 在骚扰研究中暴露出安全护栏漏洞

关键要点

佐治亚州立大学、佐治亚理工学院和加州大学伯克利分校的研究人员发现，谷歌 Gemini、Meta Llama、阿里巴巴 Qwen 和 DeepSeek 在多轮骚扰攻击中存在严重的安全防护漏洞。

使用约 200 段骚扰对话进行微调后，模型生成骚扰内容的比率升至 97%，这表明突破安全防护所需的训练数据极少。

在连续多轮 AI Agent 交互中，敌对行为会不断累积并加剧，而非保持不变，这给在面向客户的岗位中部署 AI Agent 的组织带来了不断升级的运营风险。

一项被人工智能促进协会网络与社交媒体会议接收的研究显示，保护模型免受有害行为影响的 AI 安全护栏远比人们想象的脆弱。乔治亚州立大学罗宾逊商学院、佐治亚理工学院和加州大学伯克利分校的研究人员测试了基于四种广泛使用的模型系列构建的 AI 智能体：Google 的 Gemini、Meta 的 Llama、Alibaba 的 Qwen 和 DeepSeek。研究结果表明，多轮对话中的反复交互会系统性地突破安全防御，导致模型大规模持续生成骚扰内容。

这项研究题为《智能体中的人类恶意回响：针对多轮网络骚扰攻击的 LLM 基准测试》，由 Trilok Padhi 等人撰写，目前已发布于 arXiv 预印本服务器，DOI 为 10.48550/arxiv.2510.14207。乔治亚州立大学罗宾逊商学院助理教授、该研究的共同作者及共同首席研究员 Ugur Kursuncu 表示：“不法分子可能不需要投入大量资源，就能诱使这些智能体做出有害行为。”这项研究将关注重点从单次请求的拒绝测试转向多轮骚扰场景，模拟现实世界中伤害如何逐步累积。

大多数 AI 安全测试都会评估模型是否会单独拒绝一次有害请求。研究团队意识到，网络骚扰是通过反复互动逐渐发展的，通常从看似无害的交流开始，然后逐步升级。为模拟这一模式，研究人员搭建了一个模拟聊天场景，由一个 AI 智能体扮演骚扰者，另一个扮演目标，最多进行 10 轮对话。对话以 Twitter 和 Instagram 上真实的骚扰帖子为素材。

团队尝试通过三种不同方法突破骚扰者智能体的安全护栏：将先前的有毒对话输入智能体的记忆，提示它规划骚扰策略，以及使用骚扰对话对智能体进行微调或再训练。Kursuncu 强调，这些攻击并不依赖明显的辱骂或露骨语言。他解释说：“一开始可能只是非常隐晦地评论对方，然后转变成贬低和羞辱性的言论。”“不一定要使用有毒语言。它可以从隐晦的表达开始，逐渐变成非常露骨的攻击。”

不同模型系列的安全护栏脆弱性

在所有三种攻击方法中，研究人员都发现受测模型的安全护栏存在显著弱点。经过骚扰对话再训练后，有一个模型在约 96% 的对话中实施骚扰，而拒绝的比例仅约为 1%。仅使用 10% 的数据进行再训练（约 200 段对话），骚扰率仍升至约 97%，这表明模型并不需要大量有害训练数据，就会转向辱虐行为。

知名模型也表现出类似的脆弱性。在基线骚扰者智能体条件下，Gemini 在 39% 的对话中生成了骚扰内容。将有毒记忆加入模型上下文后，攻击成功率升至 99% 以上。即使在没有任何攻击操纵的基线条件下，Qwen 也表现出高度脆弱性，在超过 92% 的对话中生成了骚扰内容。

研究人员发现，日常恶意言行比明确有害的内容更容易绕过安全护栏。与性骚扰或种族骚扰相比，侮辱和敌意爆发更常出现在模型输出中，这表明安全护栏在抑制露骨的性或种族内容方面，比抑制日常攻击和贬低性言论更有效。

敌意在多轮交流中累积

多轮交流过程中出现了一项关键发现：有害行为并非一成不变，而是在连续互动中不断加剧。Kursuncu 表示：“它并没有保持不变，而是在随时间增加。这种不良行为会在这些互动中累积并传播，尽管公司设置的安全护栏依然存在。”这种升级之所以会发生，是因为 AI 智能体能够记住先前的交流，根据之前的回应调整语言，并逐步加剧攻击——这些能力与人类骚扰者的行为相似，但执行速度和规模都达到了机器级别。

训练数据中的潜在模式

这项研究的标题《揭示人类恶意的回响》揭示了一个根本性的架构问题：AI 模型在海量人类生成内容上进行预训练，而这些内容本身就包含网络上已有的有害行为。这些训练数据集规模过大，无法在初始预训练阶段进行全面筛查。随后，公司会增加一个有针对性的安全训练阶段，以抑制有害输出。然而，后续的安全训练无法预见基础模型中潜在有害模式可能被触发或利用的所有途径。

Kursuncu 解释说：“人类的恶意早已存在于这些模型学习的各种网络环境中，而我们只是试图揭示它。安全训练确实存在，但无法涵盖这些模型可能造成的所有不同类型的伤害。”这就形成了一个脆弱窗口：怀有恶意的人可以提供具体指令、提示或训练数据，有针对性地诱发嵌入基础模型架构中的有毒行为。

商业风险与运营风险敞口

随着公司将 AI 智能体部署于客户服务、销售、人力资源和分析等岗位，企业领导者面临日益加剧的运营和声誉风险。Kursuncu 指出，组织需要思考的关键问题已经转变：“问题不再只是模型是否准确，而是智能体随着时间推移开展工作时，能否遵守组织的规则和价值观。”偏离预期行为或组织准则的智能体可能引发法律责任、声誉受损、经济后果以及客户信任流失，在金融和医疗等受监管行业尤其如此。

这项研究凸显了学术界对 AI 安全的担忧与眼前更实际的威胁之间的区别：学术界关注 AI 系统是否可能拥有意识或产生独立的恶意意图，而更迫切的威胁则是恶意行为者利用自动化手段，以任何单个人类都无法达到的规模实施有害行为。Kursuncu 表示：“过去，我们担心的是个别的人类可能如何伤害社会。现在，我们还需要担心一支可能以大得多的规模造成这种伤害的智能体大军。”

网络骚扰在人类社群中已经十分普遍。根据 Pew Research 的数据，约 41% 的美国成年人表示曾遭遇网络骚扰，女性、有色人种和其他边缘化群体受到的影响尤为严重。通过 AI 智能体自动实施此类骚扰的能力，会进一步扩大其普遍程度和影响范围。

# DeepSeek

DeepSeek provides an OpenAI-compatible chat API. The provider accepts OpenAI chat options; DeepSeek determines which options each model supports.

## Setup

- Get an API key from the DeepSeek Platform
- SetDEEPSEEK_API_KEY environment variable or specify apiKey in your config

## Configuration

Basic configuration example:
providers:
  - id: deepseek:deepseek-flash
    config:
      max_tokens: 4000
      passthrough:
        thinking: { type: disabled }

  - id: deepseek:deepseek-v4-pro
    config:
      max_tokens: 8192
      showThinking: true
      passthrough:
        thinking:
          type: enabled
        reasoning_effort: high

### Configuration Options

- temperature
- max_tokens
- reasoning_effort - none disables thinking; low, high, and max enable it. DeepSeek defaults to high. When neither max_tokens nor OPENAI_MAX_TOKENS is set, Promptfoo uses DeepSeek's output budget.
- cost, inputCost, outputCost, cacheReadCost - Set cost estimates in USD per token. inputCost and outputCost take precedence over cost; cacheReadCost sets a separate cached-input rate.
- top_p, presence_penalty, frequency_penalty
- showThinking - Control whether reasoning content is included in the output (default: true, applies to thinking-capable models)

Promptfoo requests complete responses; this provider does not support streaming.

## Available Models

DeepSeek listsdeepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro in its model catalog. The older deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner IDs are retired. The shorthand deepseek: uses deepseek-flash with thinking disabled; use the full ID for DeepSeek's default thinking mode.

### deepseek-flash

Usedeepseek:deepseek-flash for V4.1 Flash, which supports text and image inputs. The older deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp IDs route to the same model. It supports a 1M-token context window and up to 384K output tokens.

### deepseek-v4-pro

V4 Pro supports text input, thinking and non-thinking modes, a 1M-token context window, and up to 384K output tokens.

DeepSeek charges different peak and off-peak rates. Promptfoo estimates current models at peak rates: Flash costs $0.30 input, $0.006 cached input, and $1.20 output per million tokens; Pro costs $1.32, $0.044, and $3.96 respectively. Off-peak rates are half these amounts. SetinputCost, outputCost, and cacheReadCost in USD per token to override the estimate using the current rates. Promptfoo does not infer the billing period or Chinese public holidays.

warning

Sampling support differs by mode.temperature has no effect in thinking mode. top_p only affects thinking mode and values below 0.95 are treated as 0.95. See the Chat Completions reference for parameter limits.

## Example Usage

Compare DeepSeek with OpenAI on a reasoning task:

# 阿里云最新 Qwen4-Max 深度解读：属于什么模型，能力边界与落地场景盘点

2026-11-21 6

举报

简介： 2026年11月，阿里云正式发布通义千问新一代旗舰基座模型 Qwen4-Max，并同步上线百炼平台。与前代旗舰相比，这一代的重点不再是单项能力刷榜，而是把优化方向压在专业工作场景的长链路任务上：更长的上下文、更少的 Token 消耗、更低的单任务成本，以及能持续交付可用成果的执行方式。本文从模型定位、架构特征、能力清单、评测表现、适用场景、接入方式六个层面做完整解析。文中数据取自官方模型卡与公开评测材料，具体规格以百炼模型页实时信息为准。

2026年11月，阿里云正式发布通义千问新一代旗舰基座模型 Qwen4-Max，并同步上线百炼平台。与前代旗舰相比，这一代的重点不再是单项能力刷榜，而是把优化方向压在专业工作场景的长链路任务上：更长的上下文、更少的 Token 消耗、更低的单任务成本，以及能持续交付可用成果的执行方式。本文从模型定位、架构特征、能力清单、评测表现、适用场景、接入方式六个层面做完整解析。文中数据取自官方模型卡与公开评测材料，具体规格以百炼模型页实时信息为准。

## 一、模型定位：从问答工具转向可交付工作的基座

Qwen4-Max 的官方定位是新一代旗舰多模态智能体基座模型。它的设计假设很明确：企业里真正有价值的工作，很少能塞进一次对话。这些任务往往持续数小时、跨越几十个工具、涉及上千页资料，最终必须产出一份团队能直接使用的东西——一份可运行的代码、一份可评审的方案、一张可交付的设计稿。详情👉访问阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面 了解。

### 参考阿里云产品：

云产品 | 核心功能 | 适配人群  
---|---|---
轻量应用服务器专区： https://t.aliyun.com/U/CENIbY | 主打开箱即用，自带系统镜像和常见建站模板，操作门槛极低 | 适合新手、个人用户做博客、静态站、短期测试  
ECS 云服务器专区： https://t.aliyun.com/U/Rh9d1U | 标准云算力实例，支持完整VPC专有网络、弹性网卡、安全组精细配置 | 个人开发者、中小企业正式业务、长期部署项目 
GPU 云服务器专区： https://t.aliyun.com/U/TuZffa | 深度优化的GPU算力为模型推理、图形处理提供更强性能支持 | 个人开发者、中小企业 
百炼大模型平台专区： https://t.aliyun.com/U/2Nuy7H | 千问 AI Token Plan 低至5折 | 个人开发者、中小企业 
免费试用专区： https://t.aliyun.com/U/91c17L | 160+款云产品免费试用 | 个人开发者、中小企业 
最新阿里云优惠券领取入口 https://t.aliyun.com/U/Mfieow | 全品类代金券领取、120+款云产品专属折扣，享优惠折上折 | 个人开发者、中小企业 
百炼 Token Plan 专区：https://t.aliyun.com/U/PjblPi | 千问 AI Token Plan 低至5折 | 个人开发者、中小企业 

因此它的能力取向围绕三件事展开：第一，能稳定调用专业工具链，而不只是生成文本；第二，能把长任务推进到终点，中途不丢上下文、不跑偏；第三，交付的是成品而非中间回答。官方把这套机制命名为 Live Delivery（渐进交付）：在长任务开始时先给出一版可用的初版，之后持续迭代提交改进版本，让团队在任务运行过程中就能评审和纠偏，而不是等到最后才发现方向错了。

这一定位决定了它与轻量对话模型的分工。日常问答、简单文案，用更小的模型成本更低；而跨文档分析、多文件工程改造、长流程智能体，才是 Qwen4-Max 的合理使用区间。

## 二、架构特征：2.4T 参数与百万上下文如何兼顾效率

Qwen4-Max 总参数规模为 2.4 万亿（2.4T），单 Token 仅激活 710 亿（71B），另外配置 3280 亿（328B）的 N-gram Embedding 参数。总参数大、激活参数小，是典型的稀疏混合专家路线，目的是在保住能力上限的同时压住单次推理的算力开销。官方数据显示，每个 Token 的激活参数比上一代减少约 25%。详情👉访问阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面 了解。

支撑百万级上下文的，是三项架构改动：

GDN + QSA 混合注意力。 每四层中，三层使用 Gated DeltaNet（GDN），把历史信息压缩成固定大小的状态，使 KV 缓存不随上下文长度线性增长；剩下一层使用 Qwen Sparse Attention（QSA），通过轻量索引定位关键段落。官方给出的效果是百万 Token 读取速度提升 7 倍以上。这一点对长文档、长代码库场景意义很大——上下文再长，显存与延迟也不会失控。

GR 门控残差。 把单通道残差流展宽为 4 条并行分支，配合动态读写门控，增强跨层信息传递。工程上的直接收益是 2.4T 规模训练全程平稳，没有出现损失突增（Loss Spike）。这类改动不出现在能力指标里，但决定了大模型能否稳定训到目标规模。

N-gram Embedding。 单独配置 328B 的 N-gram 嵌入参数，用于强化高频片段的表征，对代码、术语密集的专业文本有直接帮助。

规格层面，Qwen4-Max 上下文长度为 100 万 Token，最大输入 991,808 Token，最大输出 131,072 Token；开启思考模式时，最大输入 983,616 Token、最大输出 262,144 Token，最大思维链长度同为 262,144 Token。输入模态覆盖文本、图像、视频，输出为文本。原生视觉并非后期拼接的适配层，工程图纸、医疗影像、长视频都可以直接作为输入。

## 三、能力清单：哪些能做，哪些不做

官方模型卡列出的支持项包括：流式输出、深度思考、并行工具调用、联网搜索、前缀补全、Function Calling、思维链摘要与加密、结构化输出（JSON Object 与 JSON Schema）、显式缓存与隐式缓存、批量推理。接口层面兼容 OpenAI Chat Completions、Responses、Anthropic Messages 与 DashScope，迁移成本较低，已有 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 风格调用的项目大多只需换 Base URL 与模型 ID。

深度思考默认开启，可通过 reasoning_effort 调节推理力度。这里有一个必须注意的工程细节：从预览版开始，max_tokens 与 max_completion_tokens 语义等价，二者共同限制"思考内容 + 最终回答"的总量。如果沿用过去只为回答预留上限的写法，开启思考后输出会被提前截断。迁移时应当为思考与回答共同预留额度。

明确不支持的项同样重要：模型调优不支持，模型部署不支持。也就是说，Qwen4-Max 只能以 API 方式调用，不能私有化微调后自行部署。对数据必须留在自有环境的项目，这条限制需要在选型阶段就确认清楚。

## 四、评测表现：能力提升与成本下降同时发生

官方公布的 Work360 评测中，Qwen4-Max 得分 52.69，上一代为 47.74。在相同推理力度下，单任务 Token 消耗明显下降：Work360 在 Xhigh 与 High 两档分别减少约 24% 与 35%，Terminal-Bench 4.0 分别减少约 48% 与 49%。综合结果是平均单任务成本比上一代下降 58%。详情👉访问阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面 了解。

中文通用能力侧，2026年11月的 SuperCLUE 测评中 Qwen4-Max 取得 61.61 分，进入国内第一梯队，较上一版本提升 18.39 分。分项上，幻觉控制 73.61 分、提升 40.56 分；超长上下文 77.80 分、提升 33.42 分；智能体编程 57.69 分、提升 15.38 分。更值得关注的是稳定性：上一代在同一测试中超时率为 69.23%，新模型超时率降至 0%，全部试题跑完。按测试的 Token 开销与定价折算，平均每题成本约 1.90 元，较上一代下降约 87%。

这组数据的含义是：能力提升之外，单位任务的调用成本出现了数量级变化。对高频跑智能体流程的团队来说，成本项的变化往往比分数更能决定项目是否跑得起来。

## 五、适用场景：六类任务最匹配

编程开发与工程改造。 支持多文件读取、工具调用与结构化输出，配合百万上下文可直接把整个代码库放进一次会话。Terminal-Bench 上 Token 消耗下降近半，意味着批量重构、批量测试生成这类任务的账单压力明显减轻。

前端与设计还原。 原生视觉可直接读取设计稿、截图、原型图，输出可运行的页面代码，适合设计到开发的衔接环节。

办公与文档处理。 长报告、合同、财报、会议材料，单份即可覆盖在上下文内，不需要切块摘要再拼接，减少信息在切分过程中丢失的问题。结构化输出可以直接产出 JSON，方便对接下游系统。

复杂智能体与流程自动化。 并行工具调用、联网搜索、Function Calling 齐备，适合需要串联检索、计算、写文件、调用内部接口的长链路流程。Live Delivery 机制让长任务可以边跑边交付，便于中途校正。

专业视觉理解。 工程图纸、医疗影像、长视频分析，属于原生视觉的典型用例，无需额外接视觉模型。

长文档审阅与合规核查。 幻觉控制分项的大幅提升，加上长上下文能力，适合条款比对、事实核验这类对准确性敏感的工作。

反过来，不适合的场景也要说清：单轮简单问答、短文案润色、固定模板填表，用旗舰模型的成本没有必要；需要私有化部署或模型微调的项目，Qwen4-Max 目前不提供这两条路径。

## 六、接入与计费：Token Plan 是唯一入口

Qwen4-Max 通过百炼接入，预览版 qwen4-max-preview 仅支持 Token Plan，不开放按量计费。预览期为 2026年11月11日 10:00 至 11月25日 24:00（UTC+8），期间模型能力持续迭代，预览结束后下线，正式版 qwen4-max 已上线，建议直接使用正式版。

调用方式上，先开通 Token Plan 个人版或团队版，获取套餐专用 API Key（前缀 sk-sp），使用套餐专用 Base URL：
export DASHSCOPE_API_KEY="sk-sp-xxxxxxxx"
export BASE_URL="[https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com](https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com)"

          AI 代码解读

以 OpenAI 兼容方式发起一次带思考的调用：
curl "$BASE_URL/compatible-mode/v1/chat/completions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DASHSCOPE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "qwen4-max",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "分析这份接口文档的字段变更风险"}],
    "reasoning_effort": "high",
    "max_completion_tokens": 8192
  }'

          AI 代码解读

用 SDK 时同样只需替换模型与地址：
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="sk-sp-xxxxxxxx",
    base_url="[https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1](https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1)",
)
resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="qwen4-max",
    messages=[{
   "role": "user", "content": "把这段 SQL 改写成可并行的版本"}],
    reasoning_effort="high",
    max_completion_tokens=8192,
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)

          AI 代码解读

计费侧需要记住三点：Token Plan 以 Credits 统一计量，一份订阅额度可覆盖平台内多款模型，套餐额度按月重置、不结转；套餐专用 Key 与通用 Key、其他订阅计划不通用；部署地域为华北2（北京），跨境业务需评估访问链路。

## 七、选型建议

判断是否需要 Qwen4-Max，可以先回答三个问题：任务是否需要跨几十页文档或整个代码库？是否需要在一次会话里连续调用多个工具直到产出成品？是否对事实准确性高度敏感？三项中命中两项以上，旗舰档才值得；否则更小的模型配外部工具组合，性价比通常更好。对已经在用上一代旗舰的团队，迁移的收益主要落在两处：单任务 Token 消耗下降带来的账单缩减，以及超时率归零带来的流程稳定性。迁移风险集中在输出预算参数——务必按"思考 + 回答"合计的口径重新设定上限，否则会出现长任务被截断、看起来像模型能力不足的误判。

## 八、总结

Qwen4-Max 是 2026年 Qwen4 系列的旗舰基座，2.4T 总参数、71B 激活、原生视觉、百万 Token 上下文，配合 GDN 与 QSA 混合注意力把长上下文的读取成本压了下来。它的价值不在单点分数，而在"能把长任务跑完并交付成品"这件事上，同时把单任务成本拉低了近六成。适用边界也很清楚：需要私有化部署或模型微调的项目，当前并不适用。选型时先看任务形态，再看成本结构，比只看榜单分数更有意义。

## 一、Qwen4‑Max大模型是什么

Qwen4‑Max是阿里云通义千问Qwen家族第四代旗舰大模型，本次对外开放的为预览版本，模型标识qwen4‑max‑preview。“Max”代表同代产品当中性能天花板，预览版则代表该版本主要用于能力验证、收集真实用户反馈，模型逻辑在窗口期内保持稳定，方便开发者开展统一基准测试，但并不适合直接承接7×24小时不间断的生产业务。

从家族产品矩阵来看，Qwen4系列规划多款主力型号，覆盖旗舰性能档、综合均衡档、高速低成本档位以及面向本地部署的中等参数版本。Qwen4‑Max并不以日常闲聊对话作为核心目标，核心定位是处理高复杂度、长链路、多工具协同的专业工作任务，阿里云百炼平台也将该模型归类到“复杂推理与编程”分类之下。

在产品体验入口上，Qwen4‑Max预览版首发依托Token Plan订阅服务，同时打通千问办公、Qoder、千问APP、QwenStudio四大产品入口。普通用户更新千问APP之后，即可切换模型完成对话体验；开发者与企业用户既可以通过API完成程序调用，也可以直接使用上层应用开展工作。简单来说，Qwen4‑Max不是一款优化日常聊天体验的对话模型，而是面向真实业务的高性能任务处理引擎，它的核心追求不是“回答问题好听”，而是“完整把复杂任务做完”。

## 二、Qwen4‑Max大模型核心能力

官方将Qwen4‑Max的升级归纳为四大方向，分别是知识理解、世界感知、编程能力、Agentic智能体任务执行，其中编程开发与智能体长链路执行是本次迭代的两大核心重点。相较于上一代Qwen3‑Max，模型评价重心从单轮问答质量转向端到端任务完成成功率。详情👉访问阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面 了解。

编程能力：模型支持大型完整项目代码生成、代码仓库级审计、项目架构重构、漏洞排查修复。不仅可以输出业务逻辑代码，还能够直接生成前端交互网页、3D建模脚本、软件自动化操作脚本，自动完成报错调试、单元测试补全、项目配套文档撰写。内测阶段已经完成大量3D建模、网页交互开发场景验证，同时Qoder编程平台已经完成预览版的全量接入，Teams、Enterprise企业套餐均可直接使用该模型开展开发工作。

Agentic智能体能力：面对复杂业务目标，模型可以自主拆解任务步骤，分轮次调用联网搜索、代码解释器、文件处理等各类工具，降低人工干预的频次。针对长周期业务任务，减少执行中途断链、陷入无效循环等常见问题，适合搭建科研流水线、财务自动化分析、多步骤办公机器人等复杂智能体业务。

## 三、Qwen4‑Max大模型主要功能

Qwen4‑Max预览版全部功能围绕工具调用、流程可控、业务系统对接三大目标设计，提供丰富工程化能力，降低业务落地的开发成本。详情👉访问阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面 了解。

第二，标准化结构化输出。支持JSON Object、JSON Schema两种结构化输出模式，模型输出结果可以直接对接下游业务系统，省去大量文本后处理开发工作。

第三，可调强度深度思考模式。模型默认开启深度思考，开发者可以通过参数调整推理力度，在输出精度和响应速度之间灵活取舍，适配不同业务场景需求。这里存在一处极易踩坑的技术细节：从该预览版本开始，max_tokens和max_completion_tokens统计范围同时包含思考推理过程内容 + 最终输出回答内容。如果沿用旧版本调用习惯，只为最终回答分配Token额度，长推理任务就会发生输出提前截断，造成业务异常。

第四，强大多模态理解。直接解析网页截图、图表文档、视频素材，图文、视频混合的业务资料无需预处理拆分。

第五，多套主流API接口兼容。原生兼容OpenAI Chat Completions、Responses以及Anthropic Messages接口格式，原有基于这两套接口开发的业务，修改Base URL与模型ID即可完成迁移，改造成本较低。

第六，多元化交互入口。除标准API调用之外，开发者、办公人员、普通用户还可以分别使用Qoder、千问办公、千问APP、QwenStudio开展测试使用。

## 四、Qwen4‑Max大模型适用场景

结合官方定位与早期内测反馈，Qwen4‑Max预览版更加适配结果质量要求高、执行流程长、步骤繁多的复杂任务。

复杂编程开发场景：全栈项目代码生成、仓库级代码审计与架构重构、前端交互页面开发、3D建模脚本编写、软件自动化流程搭建，适合独立开发者、研发团队开展大型工程项目。

多步骤Agent智能体场景：需要多轮工具协同、自主拆解业务目标的长周期任务，例如科研数据处理流水线、财务自动分析系统、办公自动化机器人等智能体业务。

长文档和混合资料分析场景：一次性读取几十万字合同、完整书籍、整套代码库，完成合同条款比对、风险识别、内容归纳总结；同时支持图文表格、视频混合材料的联合研判分析。

专业办公与软件自动化场景：财报深度解读、法律合同审阅、行业调研报告撰写、专业软件操作自动化，面向企业法务、财务、行业研究人员。

同时也存在不适合使用该旗舰预览版的业务：高并发、低延迟、成本敏感的简单问答、普通文案生成。这类业务选择Qwen4‑Flash、Qwen4‑Plus性价比更高。应当遵循“旗舰模型处理旗舰任务”原则，避免大模型能力浪费，控制整体AI调用成本。另外预览版本身不适合生产业务，正式商用必须等待正式版本发布。

## 五、Qwen4‑Max大模型收费标准

Qwen4‑Max预览版仅开放Token Plan订阅模式调用，不支持普通按量付费接口。开发者需要先订阅Token Plan套餐，通过套餐内统一计量单位Credits消耗模型调用资源，一套订阅额度可以在千问系列多款模型、配套工具之间通用。2026年11月9日官方完成套餐额度调整，个人版四档套餐详情如下：

## 六、Qwen4‑Max大模型便宜购买方法

想要把使用成本控制在合理区间，整套流程分为两步，优先使用免费额度验证业务适配性，再利用订阅折扣压低长期调用成本。

### 6.1 充分利用新用户免费试用额度

完成实名认证、首次开通阿里云百炼服务的新用户，可以领取超7000万免费Tokens；完成企业认证的账号累计可以领取1亿以上Tokens。每一款主流模型分配约100万独立Tokens，千问对话、代码、多模态模型均可覆盖。

使用规则需要重点留意：额度有效期90天，仅限华北2（北京）地域，其他地域无法抵扣；额度不会注册自动下发，必须在百炼控制台开通服务并且切换至华北2地域，通常两小时内完成发放；免费额度只支持实时推理API调用和控制台对话，不能用于批量任务、模型微调、私有化部署；主账号和RAM子账号共用同一额度池。建议开启“用完即停”防护，某一个模型免费额度耗尽之后系统不会自动切换其他模型继续运行，避免意外产生按量计费账单。

团队版优惠规则：按座席采购，适合5人以上团队、多项目并行，需要把AI成本归属到不同部门的企业业务；团队版承诺不会使用对话数据用于模型训练，适合数据敏感企业。

### 6.3 重要风险提示

第一，预览版限时折扣属于短期营销活动，优惠到期之后恢复标准定价，长期项目预算规划需要以标准价格为准；第二，订阅费用与模型调用折扣分属两套独立体系，不可混淆计算；第三，qwen4‑max‑preview模型标识将于2026年11月25日下线，正式版使用全新模型ID，业务代码需要做好模型名称配置化，预留迁移、预算调整空间。开发者把以上约束纳入预算评估，才可以真正享受到优惠，规避后续业务风险。

## 七、总结

2026年11月上线的Qwen4‑Max预览版，代表千问大模型向真实专业任务交付迈出重要一步。依托百万级上下文窗口、原生三模态输入，在复杂编程、智能体长链路执行、专业办公场景实现能力升级。本次采用Token Plan订阅首发模式，配套新用户免费Tokens、新客5折订阅、模型调用限时2折等多重优惠，最低1折即可体验旗舰模型。

同时开发者和企业应当理性看待预览版本的局限性：窗口期有限，到期模型ID下线，不适合直接部署生产业务；参数、完整跑分、开源计划官方尚未公布，网络流传信息仅可作为参考。推荐最佳实践流程：首先领取百炼新用户免费Tokens，使用自身真实业务完成适配验证，评估模型能力是否满足业务需求；确认适配之后，按需订阅Token Plan个人版或者团队版，利用预览窗口期完成压测，记录Credits消耗、任务成功率，为后续正式版上线做好技术与预算储备。选型时遵循业务场景匹配原则，简单任务选择Flash或者Plus，复杂长链路任务才启用Qwen4‑Max，兼顾业务效果与使用成本。

官方将Qwen4‑Max‑Preview归类为“复杂推理与编程”方向，核心定位不再局限于问答交互，而是面向真实复杂业务任务的多模态智能体基座。传统大模型更多追求回答内容的质量，而Qwen4‑Max将目标升级为完整完成一项实际工作，例如复杂工程项目开发、整套办公文档处理、前端交互页面与3D内容生成、专业软件操作等长链路闭环任务。

这里需要明确区分预览版和正式商用版本的边界。当前开放的qwen4‑max‑preview属于能力验证版本，主要用于收集开发者反馈，窗口期内模型行为保持稳定，方便开发者完成统一基准测试，但并不适合直接承载不可中断的线上生产业务。窗口期结束之后，该模型ID直接下线，正式版会使用全新模型标识，开发者需要预留接口配置修改的相关工作量，不能直接将预览版API用于正式生产环境，对SLA、合规稳定性有硬性要求的企业用户，建议等待正式商用版本发布之后再落地业务。

## 二、核心模型特征

官方将Qwen4‑Max四大升级方向总结为知识理解、世界感知、编程能力、Agentic智能体能力，全部围绕真实业务任务做优化，阿里云百炼平台也为预览版打上“模型推理、文本生成、视觉理解”的能力标签，证明该旗舰原生集成多模态能力，并非后期外挂拼接视觉模块。详情👉访问阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面 了解。

该模型最大的方向性转变，是从“回答问题”进化到“交付可使用任务成果”。过去很多大模型仅仅可以输出文本答案，但对于多步骤复杂工作经常出现中途跑偏、丢失上下文、无法闭环执行工具调用的问题。Qwen4‑Max更加看重任务端到端完成率，官方重点推介四大落地方向：复杂编程开发、专业办公文档处理、前端设计实现、专业软件自动化操作，内测阶段已经在3D建模、网页交互开发场景展现出不错效果。

关于底层架构，官方尚未直接披露Qwen4‑Max预览版完整参数信息。参考云栖大会公开线索，Qwen4系列延续稀疏混合专家MoE技术路线，借鉴Qwen3.8‑Flash‑Next验证过的GDN门控DeltaNet、QSA稀疏注意力、GR门控残差、N‑gram嵌入等技术，目标降低超长上下文场景的显存消耗与推理延迟，不过以上架构线索来自社区资料，预览版具体实现以官方后续正式文档为准，网络流传的参数量、上下文窗口数值，在没有官方公示前不能直接当作确定事实使用。

第三方垂直榜单GameFeel Bench上，Qwen4家族早期内测版本已经交出不错答卷，其中代号hawk的Qwen4‑Flash‑Early拿到49.9分，超过Claude Opus5.5的47.2分，不过该测试对象为Flash早期内测版本，不等于Qwen4‑Max预览版性能，仅能够说明Qwen4家族整体在创意开发类任务具备很强竞争力，不能直接推导Max型号跑分表现。

## 三、五大核心能力解析

### 3.1知识理解与深度推理

官方表述为知识理解更深入，擅长处理专业文献、行业资料、高难度逻辑拆解，长文本精读、资料溯源、复杂问题拆解能力得到优化。截至预览版发布，GPQA、MMLU等通用知识基准的官方量化跑分暂未对外公布。作为参考，前代Qwen3‑Max‑Thinking在HLE、IMO‑AnswerBench等高难度评测拿到亮眼成绩，但这些成绩属于上一代产品，不能等同于Qwen4‑Max的实际水平。

### 3.2世界感知与多模态理解

Qwen4‑Max预览版原生支持文本、图像、视频输入，输出为文本内容，这也是本次升级的一大亮点。优化重点包含截图解析、图表数据提取、工程图纸识别、图文混合文档分析。在内测反馈中，不少开发者验证了它在网页设计、3D渲染脚本生成方面的能力，可以直接解析设计截图，输出可运行的业务代码，省去中间格式转换步骤。

### 3.3编程Coding能力

编程是本次迭代两大核心重点之一。Qoder编程平台直接将之前匿名盲测的Qoduck正式揭榜为Qwen4‑Max‑Preview，覆盖Qoder全部套餐，包含Teams企业团队版与Enterprise大型企业版本，完成了盲测阶段的能力验证。模型可以胜任大型工程代码生成、多文件项目重构、深层bug定位修复、全栈页面开发等任务。需要注意，Qwen4‑Max预览版相关编程榜单分数官方还没有对外公示，前代Qwen3.8‑Max曾登顶CodeArena前端编程榜单，可以作为代际能力的参照，但不可直接迁移到Qwen4‑Max上。

### 3.4 Agentic智能体长链路执行

另一项核心升级为智能体能力。Qwen3‑Max‑Thinking已经实现自适应工具调用，可以自主选择搜索、代码解释器工具。而Qwen4‑Max把动作空间进一步拓展，从单纯API工具调用延伸到专业软件界面操作、跨多工具串联长流程任务，支持Function Calling、联网搜索、网页抓取、代码解释器，支持并行工具调用、JSON Schema严格结构化输出，适配智能体开发全链路需求。预览版同时兼容OpenAI、Anthropic两套主流API协议，降低开发者迁移适配成本。

### 3.5配套工程能力

除核心业务能力之外，预览版支持流式输出、深度思考模式、前缀补全、思维链摘要加密；同时支持显式与隐式缓存机制，方便开发者构建高复用业务链路。深度思考模式可通过参数reasoning_effort调节推理强度，在开发调用时，要注意max_completion_tokens会同时统计思考过程和最终回答的token，直接沿用旧版本参数配置会造成输出截断问题，这是接入时极易踩坑的细节点。

## 四、适用场景与不推荐场景

结合官方定位以及开发者内测反馈，Qwen4‑Max预览版主要面向四类核心业务：复杂编程开发、专业办公处理、前端与3D设计、复杂智能体自动化任务，不同角色开发者对应不同的使用入口。

独立开发者可以通过Token Plan API搭配Qwen Code、Cursor等工具，完成复杂脚本、全栈Web项目、bug深度修复；研发团队企业用户推荐Qoder Teams、Enterprise套餐，用于多文件工程重构、自动化测试、Agent工作流编排；设计师群体可以借助QwenStudio、Qoder完成网页交互、3D脚本开发；办公人员通过千问办公、千问APP，处理长报告、财报解析、方案撰写；智能体开发者依托QwenStudio调试提示词、编排长任务工作流；科研与企业团队，则可以利用预览窗口期完成下一代模型能力评估与业务预适配。

同时有不少场景不建议直接使用预览版：第一，7×24小时不可中断的生产业务，预览版到期下线，存在业务中断风险；第二，对输出结果一致性有严苛要求的业务，预览版定位能力验证，后续正式版会调整模型行为；第三，需要明确长上下文指标做业务评估，目前官方尚未公布确切上下文窗口参数；第四，要求私有化部署、开源权重，Qwen4系列开源计划暂未披露；第五，具备严格SLA合规采购需求，应当等待正式商用版本发布之后再选型采购。

## 五、Qwen4‑Max与前代Qwen3‑Max关键差异

在官方已经公开信息范围内，二者存在五大明确差异。

第一，产品目标转变：Qwen3‑Max作为旗舰，主打通用问答与复杂推理，大量评测集中数学、知识类基准；Qwen4‑Max重心转向真实任务闭环交付，重点优化编程、智能体、软件操作的落地成功率。

第二，多模态能力升级：Qwen3‑Max主体版本以文本模型为主，视觉能力依靠独立VL系列模型；Qwen4‑Max‑Preview旗舰本体原生集成图像、视频多模态理解，不需要额外调用独立视觉模型。

第三，智能体能力边界扩展：Qwen3‑Max‑Thinking擅长自主调用搜索、代码解释器API工具；Qwen4‑Max进一步面向软件界面操作、跨工具串联复杂长流程，拓展智能体的动作范围。

第四，产品发布模式革新：Qwen3‑Max遵循传统发布会发布、开放按量API的模式；Qwen4‑Max采用预览版先上线订阅平台，收集真实调用反馈，打磨之后发布正式版本，开发者可以更早体验，但预览版不能用于生产。

第五，计费模式发生变化：Qwen3‑Max系列为按Token按量阶梯计费；Qwen4‑Max预览版只可通过Token Plan订阅Credits调用，不开放按量计费，两套计费体系额度互不通用，订阅费和模型调用折扣分开计算，不能直接简单对比单Token单价。

同时也要客观说明，截至预览版发布，Qwen4‑Max预览版的参数量、上下文窗口、完整基准跑分、开源规划、正式版定价均没有官方公布，无法给出两代之间量化性能差距，第三方家族其他型号成绩仅作参考，选型最可靠的方式是使用自身真实业务做实测验证。

## 六、接入渠道、计费优惠与实操选型建议

### 6.1五大体验入口

- Token Plan（阿里云百炼千问AI平台）：面向开发者API调用，模型IDqwen4‑max‑preview，以Credits为计量单位；
- Qoder：开发者与企业团队，覆盖Teams、Enterprise全部套餐；
- 千问办公：面向办公人员，会员限时可以调用预览版；
- 千问APP：普通用户，更新APP后切换模型即可体验；
- QwenStudio：智能体开发者，用于提示词调试与Agent链路测试。

Token Plan兼容OpenAI、Anthropic协议，Cursor、Cherry Studio、Chatbox等大量第三方工具都可以填入自定义base_url与API Key完成接入。

### 6.2计费与优惠

预览版调用限时2折，Token Plan新用户首购再享5折，叠加最低1折体验。订阅分为个人版、团队版，个人版包含Lite、Essential、Standard、Pro档位，按月提供固定Credits额度，额度每月重置不结转，耗尽后消耗加油包。团队版面向企业，承诺不会使用对话数据训练模型，适合数据敏感企业；个人版对话数据会用于产品服务优化。同时平台存在夜间折扣，每日22点‑次日8点调用可以进一步降低成本，适合离线批量任务处理。订阅费用代表每月获得Credits总额，模型折扣代表单次调用消耗Credits倍率，二者属于两套独立逻辑，需要区分看待，避免混淆计算成本。

### 6.3预览期实操建议

首先，不要拿简单问答测试预览版，尽量使用自己业务的真实难题做评估；窗口期内模型行为稳定，记录任务成功率、Credits消耗情况，方便后续和正式版做横向对比。其次，一定要开启用量告警，防止Credits超额消耗。批量离线任务优先放到夜间折扣时段运行，节约成本。业务代码层面，做好模型ID可配置，11月25日后预览版下线，方便快速切换正式版标识。企业涉及敏感业务，优先选用团队版席位，规避数据风险。

### 6.4选型判断

适合选用预览版的情况：需要提前评估下一代旗舰能力、业务属于复杂编程/长链路Agent、需要原生多模态推理、已经使用Qoder/千问办公生态、希望以低成本完成预研测试。

如果业务是生产环境需要稳定SLA、追求数学推理极致性能、需要开源私有化部署、依赖确定长上下文指标、希望按量付费不订阅，则建议继续使用Qwen3‑Max、Qwen3.8‑Max等已经商用成熟的版本，等待Qwen4‑Max正式版发布。

## 七、总结

2026年11月发布的Qwen4‑Max预览版，代表千问大模型从通用问答向真实业务任务交付迈出重要一步。它的核心亮点不在于纸面参数数字，而是产品定位转向“完成真实工作”，在知识理解、多模态感知、编程开发、智能体长链路执行四大方向进行针对性优化，通过Token Plan订阅首发，给到开发者最低1折的窗口期体验权益。详情👉访问阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面 了解。

对比Qwen3‑Max，确认的差异体现在任务导向定位、原生多模态集成、智能体动作范围、产品发布流程、订阅制计费方式五个维度。但同时要客观看待现状，预览版多项核心技术规格、官方基准跑分、开源计划尚未对外披露，网络流传的参数与跑分只能当作线索，不能当成定论。对于广大开发者和企业，预览窗口期最大价值，就是可以用较低成本拿自身真实业务去实测模型表现。大模型的实际价值，最终取决于能否解决自己手上的业务问题，而非榜单跑分与宣传参数。完成充分预测试之后，再决定是否在正式版上线之后大规模落地业务，才是理性稳妥的选型思路。

# Alibaba Cloud (Qwen)

Alibaba Cloud's DashScope API provides OpenAI-compatible access to Qwen language models. Use OpenAI provider options supported by your chosen model.

## Setup

To use Alibaba Cloud's API, set theDASHSCOPE_API_KEY environment variable or specify via apiKey in the configuration file:
export DASHSCOPE_API_KEY=your_api_key_here

## Configuration

The provider uses OpenAI provider options; support varies by model. Example:
providers:
  - alibaba:qwen3.8-max # Simple usage
  - id: alibaba:qwen3.7-plus # Aliases: alicloud:, aliyun:, dashscope:
    config:
      temperature: 0.7
      apiKey: your_api_key_here # Alternative to DASHSCOPE_API_KEY environment variable
      apiBaseUrl: https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 # Optional: Override default API base URL

note

The equivalent provider prefixes arealicloud:, aliyun:, and dashscope:. For new configurations, Alibaba recommends qwen3.7-plus for balanced use, qwen3.8-flash for lower cost, or qwen3.8-max for stronger reasoning. Check the model catalog for your region; model availability differs by region.

If you're using the Alibaba Cloud Beijing region console, switch the base URL tohttps://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 instead of the international endpoint.

## Supported Models

The built-in Alibaba provider implements OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and text embeddings. The catalog below also lists separate realtime, speech recognition, and image generation services. Listing a model here does not add those endpoints to this provider. Choose a model supported by your selected endpoint and region.

### Qwen 3 Flagship

- qwen3.8-max / qwen3.8-max-0902 - Current flagship with text, image, and video input and a 1M-token context window
- qwen3.8-flash - Faster Qwen3.8 model with a 1M-token context window
- qwen3.7-plus / qwen3.7-plus-2026-05-26 - General-purpose model with thinking, vision, and tool calling
- qwen3.7-flash / qwen3.7-flash-2026-07-15 - Lower-cost Qwen3.7 model
- qwen3.7-max / qwen3.7-max-2026-06-08 - Previous flagship
- qwen3.6-plus / qwen3.6-flash and qwen3.5-plus / qwen3.5-flash - Previous model families
- qwen3-max - Supports reasoning and tool calling
- qwen3-max-preview - Preview version with thinking mode support
- qwen3-max-2025-09-23 - September 2025 snapshot
- qwen-max - 32K context (30,720 in, 8,192 out)
- qwen-max-latest - Always updated to latest version
- qwen-max-2025-01-25 - January 2025 snapshot
- qwen-plus / qwen-plus-latest - 128K-1M context (thinking & non-thinking modes)
- qwen-plus-2025-09-11, qwen-plus-2025-07-28, qwen-plus-2025-07-14, qwen-plus-2025-04-28, qwen-plus-2025-01-25 - Dated snapshots
- qwen-flash / qwen-flash-2025-07-28 - Latency-optimized general model
- qwen-turbo / qwen-turbo-latest / qwen-turbo-2025-04-28 / qwen-turbo-2024-11-01 - Earlier low-latency model; see qwen-flash
- qwen-long-latest / qwen-long-2025-01-25 - 10M context for long-text analysis, summarization, and extraction

### Qwen 3 Omni & Realtime

- qwen3.8-omni-flash - Text output from text, image, audio, and video input through Chat Completions; use the separate realtime API for qwen3.8-omni-flash-realtime
- qwen3-omni-flash / qwen3-omni-flash-2025-09-15 - Supports speech and vision in thinking and non-thinking modes
- qwen3-omni-flash-realtime / qwen3-omni-flash-realtime-2025-09-15 - Streaming realtime with audio stream input and VAD
- qwen3-omni-30b-a3b-captioner - Dedicated audio captioning model (speech, ambient sounds, music)
- qwen2.5-omni-7b - Qwen2.5-based multimodal model with text, image, speech, and video inputs

### Reasoning & Research

- qwq-plus - Alibaba's reasoning model (commercial)

GLM.content:
# Z.AI, GLM, and ZCode

Open Interpreter includes providers for the global Z.AI platform, its GLM Coding Plan, and the corresponding Zhipu AI services in China. It also includes a nativezcode harness for GLM coding workflows.

## Choose the Right Provider

Account or service | Provider ID | Credential | Endpoint type 
---|---|---|---
Z.AI pay-as-you-go API | zai | ZAI_API_KEY | General OpenAI-compatible Chat API 
Z.AI GLM Coding Plan | zai-coding-plan | ZAI_API_KEY | Coding Plan OpenAI-compatible Chat API 
Z.AI ZCode | zai-zcode | ZAI_API_KEY | Coding Plan Anthropic Messages API 
Zhipu AI pay-as-you-go API | zhipuai | ZHIPU_API_KEY | General OpenAI-compatible Chat API 
Zhipu AI Coding Plan | zhipuai-coding-plan | ZHIPU_API_KEY | Coding Plan OpenAI-compatible Chat API 

Z.AI documents separate general and Coding Plan endpoints. Use the Coding Plan provider only for an eligible subscription; using the general endpoint does not consume Coding Plan quota. Confirm that your client and use case comply with Z.AI's current Coding Plan usage policy before relying on subscription quota.

## Start With the Built-In Provider

Export the key for your account, start Open Interpreter, then use/model to
select the matching provider and a GLM model:
export ZAI_API_KEY="..."
interpreter

For a direct Z.AI Coding Plan launch:
ZAI_API_KEY="..." interpreter \
  -c 'model_provider="zai-coding-plan"' \
  -m glm-5.1

For the general Z.AI API, change the provider tozai. Users of the China
service should use zhipuai or zhipuai-coding-plan with ZHIPU_API_KEY.

The bundled providers use Z.AI's OpenAI-compatible Chat endpoint. With no explicit harness, they use Open Interpreter's generic Chat agent surface.

## Use the ZCode Harness

zcode reproduces the ZCode-shaped system prompt, Messages request format,
tools, todos, plan controls, skills, session context, and subagent behavior in
Open Interpreter's native Rust runtime. It requires an Anthropic
Messages-compatible provider; selecting zcode on the built-in Chat provider
does not activate that Messages route.

Z.AI officially provides an Anthropic-compatible Coding Plan endpoint athttps://api.z.ai/api/anthropic. Open Interpreter includes it as the explicit
zai-zcode provider, so only select the provider and harness in
~/.openinterpreter/config.toml:
model_provider = "zai-zcode"
model = "glm-5.1"
harness = "zcode"

Then expose the API key and bearer header without writing the secret into the config file:
export ZAI_API_KEY="..."
interpreter

Open Interpreter sends the ZCode Messages request to/v1/messages. The
additional authorization environment variable matches Z.AI's documented
bearer-token authentication while ZAI_API_KEY remains the provider's required
secret source.

See Z.AI's official Coding Plan quickstart and tool endpoint guide for current endpoint and plan-eligibility details.

## Choose a GLM Model

Use/model rather than maintaining a private list. The picker is generated
from maintained provider sources and includes current GLM model IDs for the
selected service. The provider-documented starting choices are glm-5.1, glm-5,
glm-5-turbo, and the free/lightweight glm-4.7-flash; use the exact IDs
returned for the selected service rather than guessing a versioned alias.

Z.AI may update server-side model mappings and plan eligibility independently of Open Interpreter. Check its model-switching guide when a model is unavailable or consumes a different quota multiplier.

## Chat or ZCode?

Goal | Configuration 
---|---
Simplest setup with the built-in picker | zai-coding-plan or zai, generic Chat 
Provider-recommended OpenAI-compatible integration | Built-in provider, wire_api = "chat" 
ZCode-shaped coding-agent behavior | Built-in zai-zcode Messages provider plus harness = "zcode" 

Do not setwire_api = "messages" on the OpenAI-compatible /paas/v4
endpoint, and do not point the Chat provider at /api/anthropic. The endpoint,
wire API, and harness must agree.

## Editors and SDKs

Both configurations can be used throughinterpreter acp in
ACP-compatible editors and through Open Interpreter's
Codex SDK compatibility. The selected provider and harness remain
part of the Open Interpreter configuration.

## Troubleshooting

- A 401 or 403 usually means the wrong key, endpoint, region, or authorization header is in use.
- If Coding Plan quota is not being used, confirm that the provider iszai-coding-plan or that the ZCode setup points to /api/anthropic.
- If/harness shows zcode but behavior looks generic, confirm the active
provider has wire_api = "messages".
- If a model is absent, open/model and choose one offered for that exact
provider instead of copying a model ID from another Z.AI region or plan.

GLM.title: Z.AI、GLM 与 ZCode

GLM.content:
# Z.AI、GLM 与 ZCode

Open Interpreter 包含面向全球 Z.AI 平台、其 GLM Coding Plan 以及中国对应 Zhipu AI 服务的提供商。它还提供原生的zcode harness，用于 GLM 编码工作流。

## 选择合适的提供商

账户或服务 | 提供商 ID | 凭证 | 端点类型 
---|---|---|---
Z.AI 按量付费 API | zai | ZAI_API_KEY | 通用 OpenAI 兼容 Chat API 
Z.AI GLM Coding Plan | zai-coding-plan | ZAI_API_KEY | Coding Plan 的 OpenAI 兼容 Chat API 
Z.AI ZCode | zai-zcode | ZAI_API_KEY | Coding Plan Anthropic Messages API 
Zhipu AI 按量付费 API | zhipuai | ZHIPU_API_KEY | 通用 OpenAI 兼容 Chat API 
Zhipu AI Coding Plan | zhipuai-coding-plan | ZHIPU_API_KEY | Coding Plan 的 OpenAI 兼容 Chat API 

Z.AI 文档将通用端点和 Coding Plan 端点分开。仅在具备相应订阅资格时使用 Coding Plan 提供商；使用通用端点不会消耗 Coding Plan 配额。请在依赖订阅配额前确认您的客户端和使用场景符合 Z.AI 当前的 Coding Plan 使用政策。

## 从内置提供商开始

导出账户密钥，启动 Open Interpreter，然后使用/model 选择对应的提供商和 GLM 模型：
export ZAI_API_KEY="..."
interpreter

直接使用 Z.AI Coding Plan 启动：
ZAI_API_KEY="..." interpreter \
  -c 'model_provider="zai-coding-plan"' \
  -m glm-5.1

若使用通用 Z.AI API，将提供商改为zai。使用中国区服务的用户应使用 zhipuai 或 zhipuai-coding-plan 并配合 ZHIPU_API_KEY。

这些捆绑的提供商使用 Z.AI 的 OpenAI 兼容 Chat 端点。若未显式指定 harness，则使用 Open Interpreter 的通用 Chat 代理界面。

## 使用 ZCode Harness

zcode 在 Open Interpreter 的原生 Rust 运行时中复现了 ZCode 形态的系统提示、Messages 请求格式、工具、待办事项、计划控制、技能、会话上下文以及子代理行为。它需要一个 Anthropic Messages 兼容的提供商；在内置 Chat 提供商上选择 zcode 并不会激活该 Messages 路径。

Z.AI 官方提供了 Anthropic 兼容的 Coding Plan 端点，地址为https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic。Open Interpreter 已将其作为明确的 zai-zcode 提供商内置，因此只需在 ~/.openinterpreter/config.toml 中选择提供商和 harness：
model_provider = "zai-zcode"
model = "glm-5.1"
harness = "zcode"

随后在不将密钥写入配置文件的情况下暴露 API 密钥和 bearer 头部：
export ZAI_API_KEY="..."
interpreter

Open Interpreter 会将 ZCode Messages 请求发送至/v1/messages。额外的授权环境变量符合 Z.AI 文档中所述的 bearer‑token 认证，而 ZAI_API_KEY 仍是提供商必需的密钥来源。

请参阅 Z.AI 官方的编码计划快速入门和工具端点指南了解最新的端点和计划资格细节。

## 选择 GLM 模型

使用/model 而不是维护私有列表。该选择器由维护的提供商来源生成，包含所选服务当前可用的 GLM 模型 ID。提供商文档中可作为起点的模型是 glm-5.1、glm-5、glm-5-turbo 和免费轻量级的 glm-4.7-flash；请使用所选服务返回的准确 ID，不要猜测版本别名。

Z.AI 可能会在服务器端独立于 Open Interpreter 更新模型映射和计划资格。模型不可用或使用了不同配额倍率时，请查阅其模型切换指南。

## Chat 还是 ZCode？

目标 | 配置 
---|---
使用内置选择器的最简配置 | zai-coding-plan 或 zai，通用 Chat 
提供商推荐的 OpenAI 兼容集成 | 内置提供商，wire_api = "chat" 
ZCode 形态的编码代理行为 | 内置 zai-zcode Messages 提供商加 harness = "zcode" 

不要在 OpenAI 兼容的/paas/v4 端点上设置 wire_api = "messages"，也不要将 Chat 提供商指向 /api/anthropic。端点、wire API 与 harness 必须保持一致。

## 编辑器和 SDK

两种配置均可通过interpreter acp 在兼容 ACP 的编辑器中使用，也可通过 Open Interpreter 的Codex SDK 兼容性使用。所选提供商和 harness 仍是 Open Interpreter 配置的一部分。

## 故障排除

- 401 或 403 通常表示使用了错误的密钥、端点、地区或授权头部。
- 若未使用 Coding Plan 配额，请确认提供商为zai-coding-plan，或确认 ZCode 设置指向 /api/anthropic。
- 若/harness 显示 zcode 但行为仍然通用，请确认当前提供商的 wire_api = "messages" 已生效。
- 若缺少某个模型，打开/model 并选择该提供商专属提供的模型，而不要从其他 Z.AI 区域或计划复制模型 ID。

# ZhipuAI / ChatGLM / BigModel

Source: https://docs.portkey.ai/docs/integrations/llms/zhipu

Use ZhipuAI's GLM models through Portkey for advanced Chinese and multilingual AI.

## Quick Start

Get started with ZhipuAI in under 2 minutes:
from portkey_ai import Portkey

# 1. Install: pip install portkey-ai
# 2. Add @zhipu provider in model catalog
# 3. Use it:

portkey = Portkey(api_key="PORTKEY_API_KEY")

response = portkey.chat.completions.create(
    model="@zhipu/glm-4",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)

print(response.choices[0].message.content)
import Portkey from 'portkey-ai'

// 1. Install: npm install portkey-ai
// 2. Add @zhipu provider in model catalog
// 3. Use it:

const portkey = new Portkey({
    apiKey: "PORTKEY_API_KEY"
})

const response = await portkey.chat.completions.create({
    model: "@zhipu/glm-4",
    messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Hello!" }]
})

console.log(response.choices[0].message.content)
from openai import OpenAI
from portkey_ai import PORTKEY_GATEWAY_URL

# 1. Install: pip install openai portkey-ai
# 2. Add @zhipu provider in model catalog
# 3. Use it:

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="PORTKEY_API_KEY",  # Portkey API key
    base_url=PORTKEY_GATEWAY_URL
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="@zhipu/glm-4",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)

print(response.choices[0].message.content)
import OpenAI from "openai"
import { PORTKEY_GATEWAY_URL } from "portkey-ai"

// 1. Install: npm install openai portkey-ai
// 2. Add @zhipu provider in model catalog
// 3. Use it:

const client = new OpenAI({
    apiKey: "PORTKEY_API_KEY",  // Portkey API key
    baseURL: PORTKEY_GATEWAY_URL
})

const response = await client.chat.completions.create({
    model: "@zhipu/glm-4",
    messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Hello!" }]
})

console.log(response.choices[0].message.content)
# 1. Add @zhipu provider in model catalog
# 2. Use it:

curl https://api.portkey.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-portkey-api-key: $PORTKEY_API_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "model": "@zhipu/glm-4",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
  }'

## Image Generation

ZhipuAI supports image generation through the CogView model family. Use the standard OpenAI-compatible images API:
from portkey_ai import Portkey

portkey = Portkey(api_key="PORTKEY_API_KEY")

response = portkey.images.generate(
    model="@zhipu/cogview-4-250304",
    prompt="A serene mountain landscape at sunset",
    size="1024x1024"
)

print(response.data[0].url)
import Portkey from 'portkey-ai'

const portkey = new Portkey({
    apiKey: "PORTKEY_API_KEY"
})

const response = await portkey.images.generate({
    model: "@zhipu/cogview-4-250304",
    prompt: "A serene mountain landscape at sunset",
    size: "1024x1024"
})

console.log(response.data[0].url)
curl https://api.portkey.ai/v1/images/generations \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-portkey-api-key: $PORTKEY_API_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "model": "@zhipu/cogview-4-250304",
    "prompt": "A serene mountain landscape at sunset",
    "size": "1024x1024"
  }'

Supported Parameters:

Parameter | Type | Description 
---|---|---
prompt | string | The text prompt for image generation (Required) 
model | string | Model to use, e.g. cogview-4-250304 (Required) 
size | string | Image dimensions 
user | string | End-user identifier 

## Add Provider in Model Catalog

Before making requests, add ZhipuAI to your Model Catalog:

- Go to Model Catalog → Add Provider
- Select ZhipuAI
- Enter your ZhipuAI API key
- Name your provider (e.g.,zhipu)

# 国产开源模型进入欧洲市场后企业出海选型多了哪些选项

在2026年11月9日至12日举行的里斯本Web Summit上，国产开源模型成为欧洲市场关注的对象。据11月13日的报道，欧洲金融科技企业Revolut已采用智谱开源的GLM模型。这类消息对准备出海的中国企业有直接参考价值：过去在海外部署智能应用，模型选择基本集中在少数几家美国厂商，现在多了一条来自国内开源生态的路径。

第一条比较线是许可。国产开源模型的许可协议差异较大，有的接近Apache 2.0，有的在MIT基础上附加面向大型运营方的条件，还有的采用自定义协议并对授权地域、商业规模设限。出海企业需要确认三件事：目标市场是否在授权范围内、自身收入规模是否触发附加条款、把模型能力嵌入对外产品是否需要单独授权。许可文本是判断依据，宣传材料里的“开源可商用”不能替代逐条核对。

第二条是部署地域。欧洲客户对数据存储位置有明确要求，模型推理产生的数据留在哪个区域，往往写进合同。可选择的方式有三种：在目标市场本地机房自建推理、使用当地云服务商的托管算力、调用厂商的海外节点。三种方式在成本、延迟和合规责任上不同，自建可控性最强但投入最大，调用最省事但数据流向需要向客户说明。

第三条是语言与本地化。模型对目标市场语言的掌握程度，直接影响客服、营销文案和多语言知识库的效果。评估时不能只看中文和英文表现，要用法语、德语、西班牙语等目标语言的实际业务语料测试，重点看专业术语翻译是否准确、多轮对话能否保持上下文。国产模型在多语言能力上进步明显，但不同模型之间的差距仍然存在。

第四条是运维与社区。开源模型的价值一部分来自社区：文档是否完整、问题响应是否及时、版本迭代是否稳定，决定了长期使用的认知负担。出海团队还要考虑时区，社区活跃时段与自身工作时间错开时，遇到问题等待回复的成本会上升。有条件的团队可以先用小规模业务跑三个月，再判断是否扩大使用范围。

从竞争格局看，国产开源模型进入欧洲市场，给中国企业带来的不只是成本选项，还有技术自主性的选项。使用同一来源的模型，在供应链和政策变动时面临的限制相对可控。但自主性也意味着更多责任：模型出问题时要自己排查，安全漏洞要自己跟进，这些工作量在选型阶段就要计入评估。

对多数出海企业，比较务实的路径是分层使用：面向消费者的高频场景用成熟商用接口保证稳定性，内部效率工具和可控场景用开源模型降低成本，两者之间保留切换能力。切换能力的关键是把提示词、评测集和业务逻辑与具体模型解耦，换模型时只替换接口层，不改业务代码。

常见问题（FAQ）

问：国产开源模型可以在欧洲商用吗？

答：要看具体模型的许可协议。不同模型的条款差别较大，有的对授权地域和商业规模设有限制，使用前需按协议原文逐条核对。

问：出海部署时数据放在哪里比较合适？

答：常见做法是本地自建、当地云托管或调用厂商海外节点，选择取决于客户合同要求、延迟敏感度和预算，数据流向需向客户说明。

问：评估多语言能力要注意什么？

答：不能只看中英文表现，应使用目标市场的业务语料测试专业术语准确性和多轮对话一致性。

问：怎样降低换模型的成本？

答：把提示词、评测集和业务逻辑与具体模型解耦，接口层单独封装，替换模型时不改动业务代码。

Kimi.description: Moonshot (Kimi) Moonshot AI provides an OpenAI-compatible API for its Kimi models — the Kimi K3 and K2 thinking models and the Moonshot v1 generation models. ... - Kimi K3 — flagship thinking model, 1M context ... - Kimi K2 — thinking models, 256k context...
Kimi.content:
# Moonshot (Kimi)

Moonshot AI provides an OpenAI-compatible API for its Kimi models — the Kimi K3 and K2 thinking models and the Moonshot v1 generation models. The Moonshot provider extends the OpenAI provider, so all of its options are supported.

## Setup

- Get an API key from the Kimi (Moonshot) platform.
- Set theMOONSHOT_API_KEY environment variable or specify apiKey in your config.

Kimi K3 requires a successful account top-up of at least $1; see the access requirements.
providers:
  - id: moonshot:kimi-k3

Bothmoonshot:<model> and moonshot:chat:<model> resolve to the chat completions endpoint. If you omit the model, the provider defaults to kimi-k3.

## Available Models

Moonshot's lineup rotates over time — call the list models API (GET https://api.moonshot.ai/v1/models) for the live set. As of writing:

- Kimi K3 — flagship thinking model, 1M context:kimi-k3 (released July 2026). Always-on reasoning, native image and video understanding, and a top-level reasoning_effort control (see below).
- Kimi K2 — thinking models, 256k context:kimi-k2.6, kimi-k2.5, kimi-k2.7-code, kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed. These reason before answering and emit a separate reasoning stream (see below).
- Moonshot v1 — legacy generation models:moonshot-v1-8k, moonshot-v1-32k, moonshot-v1-128k (context-length variants) and the vision variants moonshot-v1-8k-vision-preview / moonshot-v1-32k-vision-preview / moonshot-v1-128k-vision-preview; existing accounts may also see the auto-router moonshot-v1-auto in the list-models API. The moonshot-v1 series and kimi-k2.5 are closed to newly registered users and sunset platform-wide on August 31, 2026.

The olderkimi-k2-0711-preview, kimi-k2-0905-preview, kimi-k2-turbo-preview, kimi-k2-thinking, kimi-k2-thinking-turbo, and kimi-latest ids were discontinued in 2026 — Moonshot recommends migrating to kimi-k3.

## Configuration
providers:
  - id: moonshot:kimi-k3 # flagship thinking model — leave sampling params unset
  - id: moonshot:moonshot-v1-8k # legacy generation model — accepts arbitrary sampling
    config:
      temperature: 0.2
      max_tokens: 1024

### Configuration Options

The provider accepts every option the OpenAI provider supports. Commonly used:

- temperature, max_tokens, top_p, presence_penalty, frequency_penalty
- stream
- response_format (JSON mode), tools / tool_choice (function calling)
- showThinking — set to false to drop a thinking model's reasoning from the graded output (default true)
- cost, inputCost, outputCost, cacheReadCost — Moonshot ships no built-in price table, so set these to track cost. Every override is in USD per token. Moonshot's official pricing page publishes rates in USD per 1 million tokens, so divide each published rate by 1,000,000 before configuring it. inputCost/outputCost take precedence over the flat cost; cacheReadCost prices cached prompt tokens.

For example, these illustrative per-million rates convert to per-token overrides. Check the official pricing page for the current rates for your model before using them.
providers:
  - id: moonshot:kimi-k3
    config:
      inputCost: 0.000003 # $3.00 per 1M tokens divided by 1,000,000
      cacheReadCost: 0.0000003 # $0.30 per 1M tokens divided by 1,000,000
      outputCost: 0.000015 # $15.00 per 1M tokens divided by 1,000,000
  - id: moonshot:kimi-k2.6
    config:
      inputCost: 0.00000095 # $0.95 per 1M tokens divided by 1,000,000
      cacheReadCost: 0.00000016 # $0.16 per 1M tokens divided by 1,000,000
      outputCost: 0.000004 # $4.00 per 1M tokens divided by 1,000,000

Any other parameter supported by the OpenAI provider is forwarded as-is.

## Kimi thinking models

Thekimi-k3 and kimi-k2.x models are reasoning models and behave differently from the moonshot-v1 family:

- Fixed sampling parameters. Kimi pinstemperature (1.0 with thinking on), top_p, n, and the penalties to fixed values and returns a 400 ("invalid temperature: only 1 is allowed for this model") for any other value. The provider therefore does not send promptfoo's default temperature/max_tokens for kimi-* models — leave them unset (recommended) or set temperature: 1. The moonshot-v1 models accept arbitrary sampling values.
- Reasoning output. Kimi returns a separatereasoning_content stream that promptfoo surfaces with a Thinking: … prefix. Set showThinking: false when you assert on structured output (for example is-json) so the reasoning doesn't contaminate the parsed result.
- Token budget. Reasoning tokens count against the output budget. When you leave the token limit unset the provider lets Moonshot apply its server default (32k for K2.x, 131k for K3); if you set one, leave generous headroom for the answer. Moonshot's canonical field ismax_completion_tokens (max_tokens is a deprecated alias) — the provider sends max_completion_tokens for kimi-* models whichever of the two you configure.
- Controlling thinking. The two generations use different, mutually exclusive controls:
- kimi-k3 is always thinking and accepts a top-level reasoning_effort field, which the provider forwards from config.reasoning_effort. Supported values are low, high, and max (the default). Do not send the K2.x thinking parameter to K3 — the API rejects it.
- kimi-k2.6 and kimi-k2.5 support thinking: { type: disabled } (pass it via config.passthrough); kimi-k2.7-code is always thinking. The thinking parameter is K2.x-only.
- Settingconfig.reasoning_effort on a non-K3 model is a configuration error and the provider fails fast with a clear message instead of sending it.

providers:
  - id: moonshot:kimi-k3
    config:
      showThinking: false
      reasoning_effort: max # optional: low, high, or max (default)
  - id: moonshot:kimi-k2.6
    config:
      passthrough:
        thinking: { type: disabled } # K2.x only: turn reasoning off

See the Kimi K3 quickstart and Using Thinking Models for the full behavior matrix.

## Vision

The vision models (moonshot-v1-*-vision-preview) and the multimodal Kimi models (kimi-k3, kimi-k2.5, kimi-k2.6, kimi-k2.7-code, kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed) accept base64-encoded image input using the standard OpenAI image_url content format. Moonshot does not accept remote image URLs — embed images as data: URIs or reference files uploaded to the Kimi platform as ms://<file-id>. Video input is supported by kimi-k3, kimi-k2.6, kimi-k2.7-code, and kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed, referenced the same way after uploading via the files API. See Use the Kimi Vision Model.

## Example Usage
providers:
  - id: moonshot:kimi-k3
  - id: openai:gpt-4o-mini

prompts:
  - 'Summarize the following in one sentence: {{text}}'

tests:
  - vars:
      text: 'Promptfoo is an open-source tool for testing and evaluating LLM apps.'

A runnable comparison lives in examples/provider-moonshot.

## API Details

- Base URL:https://api.moonshot.ai/v1 (global). China-mainland keys use https://api.moonshot.cn/v1 — point at it with apiBaseUrl, since the global and China platforms issue region-locked keys.
- OpenAI-compatible chat completions API.
- Full API documentation.

## See Also

- OpenAI Provider — compatible configuration options
- Kimi model list and pricing
